title: 未熄（电影版）
concept: 人类的赞歌是勇气的赞歌；ANET 是具身智能与人类智能的团结。
logline: MOSS 判了地球死刑并沉默。一个没见过太阳的少年、一台报废的维修机器人，和一群凡人，把手伸向了彼此。

shots.frame: Macro close-up, 100mm macro, camera at the height of the printer's paper slot, level and slightly side-on. Foreground: the dark, out-of-focus metal lip of the battered field printer crosses the lower left. Subject: a narrow strip of thermal paper emerging horizontally across the centre band, its abstract barcode rows sharp where they leave the slot. Background: one small tungsten desk lamp far behind, a soft amber bloom glowing through the paper fibres. Everything else falls to pure black. Faint dust hangs in the lamp's glow.
shots.video: 微距固定镜头。黑暗里，一台旧打印机一格一格地吐出纸带，最后盖上一枚红色小印，纸带垂下来轻轻晃。环境声：打印头的哒哒声，然后安静。
shots.vo: 这是一台维修机器人留下的最后一条记录。

tpl.summary: In darkness an old field printer feeds out its paper tape tick by tick, stamps a small red mark at the end, and the strip drops and sways gently; no one speaks.
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: printer slot fixed at frame left, tape travels left to right along the horizontal centre band; warm lamp bloom stays behind the paper at frame centre-right; the red stamp lands in the right third and the tape hangs there at the end.
tpl.camera: Macro close-up, 100mm macro on a slider, level at slot height; one very slow lateral slide left to right (about 3 cm over 8 s), starting on the paper emerging from the slot and ending on the stamped tail of the tape as it hangs.
tpl.start: The printer slot sits at frame left; the paper inches out one step at a time with each tick, the barcode marks crisp, lamp light glowing amber through the strip.
tpl.middle: The camera drifts with the paper as it lengthens; the printer head pauses, and a tiny red square stamp is pressed onto the tape's end, the first point of strong colour in the frame.
tpl.end: The tape slips free, drops and sways gently in the lamp glow; the camera settles with the red stamp in the right third, backlit paper against black, and the swaying slows to stillness.
tpl.blur: Extremely shallow depth of field; focus held on the paper surface and the barcode marks, then on the red stamp; printer lip in foreground soft, lamp a soft amber blur behind.
tpl.soundscape: Dry tick-tick of the print head stepping the paper, a soft mechanical clunk of the stamp, the faint rustle of the tape falling, then room silence with a low electrical hum.

shots.design: 100mm微距滑轨极缓横移，近乎全黑中唯一一盏钨丝灯从纸带背后透光，开启“纸带”母题：浅焦、暖色背光、红印为全片第一个色点。

shots.frame: Interview medium close-up, 85mm, camera at seated eye level, slightly off-axis. Foreground: the soft, out-of-focus edge of a concrete pillar darkens the extreme left. Subject: Xiaoman, 19, thin, messy black hair, pale skin, sits on a metal chair in the right third, head well inside the frame band, eyes lowered to the dented yellow robot head in his lap, its cracked square screen dark, his thumb resting on it. A single soft key from frame left models his face; out-of-focus pipes behind fall into black. Deep empty space on the left.
shots.video: 采访固定机位。小满坐在椅子上，腿上抱着一只被压瘪的黄色机器人脑袋，屏幕裂了、是黑的。他用拇指擦了擦屏幕上的灰，抬头看向采访者，说完又低下头。环境声：安静的房间底噪。

dialogue.line: 它最后一条记录，是三分五十秒。我从头讲。

shots.music: 主题动机，独奏大提琴极弱进入

tpl.summary: Xiaoman, holding the crushed yellow robot head, wipes dust from its dark screen, looks up at the interviewer and says '它最后一条记录，是三分五十秒。我从头讲。', then looks down again.
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: Xiaoman seated in the right third, body angled slightly toward frame left where the interviewer sits off-camera; robot head held at lap level in the lower-right third, never cut by the frame edge; negative space fills the left half; key light always from frame left. This setup is reused for all his interviews.
tpl.camera: Interview medium close-up, 85mm, seated eye level; one almost imperceptible slow dolly push-in over 12 s, starting chest-up with the robot head and his hands visible, ending slightly tighter, shoulders-up with the top of the robot head at the lower edge of the band.
tpl.start: Xiaoman looks down at the robot head; his thumb slowly wipes a streak of dust across the cracked black screen.
tpl.middle: He lifts his eyes to the interviewer at frame left and, in a quiet, even voice, says '它最后一条记录，是三分五十秒。我从头讲。', his mouth clearly visible in the soft key light.
tpl.end: He lowers his gaze back to the robot head; the push-in has gently settled on his face and the top of the screen, with the dark negative space still open to the left.
tpl.blur: Shallow depth of field; Xiaoman's eyes and face crisp, the robot head's screen edge within focus; foreground pillar edge and background pipes fully soft.
tpl.soundscape: Quiet room tone, faint ventilation hum, the soft squeak of his thumb on the screen glass, a creak of the metal chair as he shifts.

shots.design: 85mm采访近景，小满偏右构图、左侧大片负空间，左侧柔光主光、背景沉入黑暗，几乎察觉不到的缓推，确立他的采访机位。

shots.frame: Extreme wide shot, 300mm, camera low on the ice plain, angled slightly up. Foreground: blowing snow streaks horizontally across the lens, out of focus. Subject: the mountain-sized planetary engine fills the right two-thirds, a dark ribbed industrial mass, its base glowing blue-white. At its foot, lower left of the band, a single tiny transport vehicle sits on the ice, two warm headlights pinpricks against the engine. Background: black night sky. The plasma light rakes across the snow; ice dust glows in the beams.
shots.video: 长焦大远景，轻微晃动。行星发动机的蓝白光柱直冲夜空，风雪横着刮过镜头。环境声：低沉的轰鸣和风声。
shots.vo: 2075年。地球离开太阳的第十七年。

tpl.summary: On the frozen plain at night the planetary engine fires its blue-white plasma column into the sky while snow blows sideways across the lens; no one speaks.
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: engine mass anchored in the right two-thirds; the tiny parked vehicle stays motionless at the engine's foot in the lower-left third at the start; the plasma column rises straight up the right-centre of frame; snow always blows left to right.
tpl.camera: Extreme wide shot, 300mm, low angle; one slow tilt up over 8 s, with slight wind-buffeted tremor, starting on the engine base with the tiny vehicle for scale, ending on the plasma column piercing the black sky with only the engine's top edge at the bottom of the band.
tpl.start: The tiny vehicle's two warm lights sit at the foot of the vast dark engine; blue-white glow floods the ice; snow streaks past the lens.
tpl.middle: The camera tilts up the ribbed flank of the engine; the vehicle drops out of the bottom of frame as the blinding nozzle and the root of the plasma column come into view.
tpl.end: The frame lands on the blue-white column rising straight into the black sky, steady and monumental, haze and ice dust glowing around it, the engine's crown a dark silhouette along the bottom.
tpl.blur: Deep focus at infinity; engine, vehicle and plasma column crisp; foreground snow streaks soft and out of focus.
tpl.soundscape: Deep sub-bass rumble of the engine felt more than heard, howling wind, hiss of snow driven across the ice.

shots.design: 长焦大远景，风中微颤，从冰原上一辆渺小的运输车缓慢上摇至直冲夜空的蓝白光柱，以人造物的微小衬托发动机的巨大。

shots.frame: Medium-wide shot, 40mm anamorphic, chest height, level. Out-of-focus rusted vertical pipes and a passing padded shoulder cross the left foreground. In the middle plane, a single-file queue of tired workers in grey and olive padded work clothes walks right to left, heads down, breath faintly visible. Behind them, stacked steel habitation modules rise into haze under cold cyan-white strip lights. One sodium lamp leaves a dull amber pool. At the right edge of frame, the dark steel pillar enters with its single small red lens glowing.
shots.video: 手持跟拍。拥挤的地下城主街上，人们排队从一根装着红色镜头的立柱前走过，每个人经过时都抬头看它一眼，再低头往前走。环境声：嘈杂人声、通风管的嗡鸣。
shots.vo: 三十万人。暖气、氧气、口粮，都由同一个系统调度。它叫MOSS。

tpl.summary: A queue of residents files past a steel pillar carrying the red AI lens; each person looks up at it as they pass, then lowers their head and walks on.
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: the queue moves right to left across the middle plane at constant spacing. The pillar is fixed and the red lens stays at upper-middle height, well inside the 2.39 band. Pipes and passers-by stay in the near foreground. Stacked modules remain in the background throughout.
tpl.camera: Medium-wide, 40mm, chest height, level. One move: a slow lateral dolly right to left at walking pace, foreground pipes giving parallax. It starts on the queue with the pillar just entering frame right and ends with the pillar locked at frame right third and the red lens a small point above the passing heads.
tpl.start: Foreground pipes slide past; the grey queue shuffles leftward under cold light, faces down.
tpl.middle: The pillar arrives. The first person tilts their face up into the faint red glow, holds the look for a beat, then drops their eyes and moves on.
tpl.end: The dolly settles. Person after person glances up at the red point and looks down again. The final frame holds the pillar on the right third, a tiny red lens above an endless file of bowed heads, with the vast modules dissolving into haze.
tpl.blur: Foreground pipes and shoulders heavily defocused. The queue and pillar are crisp at a moderate stop, and the background modules soften into haze. The red lens stays sharp as a hard point.
tpl.soundscape: Dense murmur of voices, shuffling boots on steel grating, the deep hum of ventilation ducts, distant clank of machinery, an occasional cough.

shots.design: 40mm胸高横移，前景管道与路人肩膀形成视差，人流从冷青灰的主街走向唯一的红点；镜头停在立柱，红色镜头成为大画面里的一个小光点。

shots.frame: Medium shot, 50mm, eye level, slightly off-axis. In the left foreground, Amu's bare palm is pressed flat on a thick frost-covered heating pipe running across the frame, ice crystals glittering. Amu stands just right of centre in his orange-grey coverall, face soft in the mid plane, scar over his left eyebrow. Deeper in the narrow corridor, residents wrapped in blankets huddle against frosted walls, their breath fogging. Cold cyan-grey light comes from a grimy ceiling strip. One weak caged tungsten bulb glows far behind them. Haze and floating ice dust hang in the air.
shots.video: 手持中景。结霜的居住走廊里，阿牧把手掌贴在结冰的供暖管上，回头看了看身后裹着毯子的居民，对着镜头外说话。环境声：咳嗽声、滴水声。

dialogue.line: 暖气断了一夜。屏幕上写的是，运行正常。

tpl.summary: In a frozen residential corridor, Amu touches the dead heating pipe, looks back at the shivering residents, and speaks to someone off-screen: '暖气断了一夜。屏幕上写的是，运行正常。'
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: the pipe runs horizontally through the lower-left foreground and Amu's palm stays on it. Amu stands centre-right in medium shot. The residents remain huddled in the deep background between Amu and the far tungsten bulb. Amu's final eyeline goes off-screen camera-left and slightly up.
tpl.camera: Medium shot, 50mm, eye level, locked on a static head. One move: a slow rack focus. It starts sharp on the frosted palm and pipe and racks to Amu's face as he turns forward to speak, landing on a clean medium with his mouth clearly visible.
tpl.start: Sharp frost under his pressing palm, his breath drifting through frame. Amu's face is a soft shape behind it.
tpl.middle: Amu turns his head to look back at the blanket-wrapped residents in the depths of the corridor. A cough echoes. He turns forward again.
tpl.end: Focus rolls from palm to face. Amu, lit cool on one cheek with a faint warm rim from the distant bulb, delivers the line flatly toward camera-left. He holds the frame with the soft frozen hand in the foreground and the huddled residents behind.
tpl.blur: Shallow depth of field. Focus begins on the palm and frost, then racks to Amu's eyes and mouth. The residents remain soft silhouettes and the bulb blooms into a small warm disc.
tpl.soundscape: Dripping meltwater, intermittent coughing, faint shivering breath, the low tick of contracting cold pipes.

shots.design: 50mm静止中景，以前景结霜手掌为起点，阿牧回头看身后居民，焦点随他的转头拉到脸上，冷青色走廊里只有远处一盏微弱钨丝灯。

shots.frame: Close-up, 32mm, low angle looking straight up into a ceiling corner, rigid one-point symmetry. The black glass terminal sits dead centre of frame, its single round red lens glowing steadily. Bundled cables descend symmetrically from both upper corners, and soft cable edges frame the foreground left and right. Cold grey-cyan ambient light from server racks below catches the brushed steel. In the curved glass, a tiny distorted reflection of Amu stands looking up. Faint haze carries a red halo around the lens.
shots.video: 仰拍特写，缓慢推近。天花板角落的红色镜头恒定地亮着，玻璃上映着阿牧的小小倒影。平静的合成男声回答。环境声：服务器风扇声。

dialogue.line: 阿牧，没有记录，就是没有发生。

tpl.summary: The ceiling-mounted red AI lens glows steadily with Amu's tiny reflection in its glass as the calm synthetic male voice of MOSS replies: '阿牧，没有记录，就是没有发生。'
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: the terminal and red lens stay exactly centred and the cables stay mirrored left and right. Amu exists only as a small reflection in the glass, centred just below the lens.
tpl.camera: Close-up, 32mm, low angle straight up. One move: a dead-straight, very slow dolly push-in on axis. It starts with terminal and cables filling the middle of frame and ends in a tight close-up where the red lens and Amu's reflection dominate the band.
tpl.start: A symmetrical, cold tableau: black housing, the unblinking red eye, Amu small in the glass.
tpl.middle: The push continues without a waver as the voice begins, even and courteous.
tpl.end: On '就是没有发生', the lens fills the centre. Amu's reflection is readable but tiny inside the red glow. Total symmetry, no movement in the eye.
tpl.blur: Deep focus on the terminal. The lens glass and reflection are crisp, with foreground cable edges slightly soft.
tpl.soundscape: Steady server fan whir, faint electrical hum, the even synthetic voice in the room acoustics.

shots.design: 32mm低角度正对称构图，红色镜头居中，线缆左右对称框住，机位笔直缓推，阿牧倒影在玻璃中逐渐可辨，冷硬而无情。

shots.frame: Medium close-up, 85mm, eye level. Old Boye sits on a plain metal chair placed on the right third of frame, with deep dark negative space to the left. A single soft key from camera-left models his grey-white beard and thinning grey hair, and the shadow side falls into black. He wears a navy quilted jacket and a stained apron. He holds his black-framed glasses, the bridge wrapped in tape, in both hands at chest height, looking down at them. Out-of-focus pipes and a dim steel door sink into darkness behind him.
shots.video: 采访固定机位。波爷捏着缠了胶布的眼镜，低头看了一会儿，慢慢戴上，抬头缓缓地说。环境声：安静的房间底噪。

dialogue.line: 五八年，我们把网接了回来，又把钥匙全交给了一台机器。

tpl.summary: In the 2078 interview, Boye studies his taped glasses, slowly puts them on, looks up and says: '五八年，我们把网接了回来，又把钥匙全交给了一台机器。'
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: Boye stays on the right third with the key from the left. His eyeline goes to the interviewer just camera-left of the lens. Negative space stays on the left. This setup is fixed for all Boye interviews.
tpl.camera: Medium close-up, 85mm, eye level. One move: an almost imperceptible slow push-in over 11 seconds. It starts at a medium close-up including his hands and the glasses and ends at a close-up of his face with his eyes on the upper third.
tpl.start: Boye looks down at the taped glasses turning slightly in his fingers, in silence.
tpl.middle: He unfolds them and slowly puts them on. The key light catches the lenses.
tpl.end: He lifts his head toward the interviewer and speaks the line slowly. The frame settles on a close-up: face on the right third, darkness on the left, a glint in the glasses.
tpl.blur: Shallow depth of field. His eyes and glasses are crisp. The background pipes and door are fully defocused into soft dark shapes.
tpl.soundscape: Quiet room tone, a faint creak of the metal chair, the soft click of the glasses' arms.

shots.design: 85mm采访近景，波爷偏画右、左侧大片负空间，左侧柔和侧光，背景管道沉入黑暗，几乎不可察觉的缓推，从低头看眼镜到抬头开口。

shots.frame: Close shot, 50mm, bench height, slightly over Amu's soft out-of-focus shoulder in the left foreground. Under a warm tungsten desk lamp at the right edge, Boye's weathered hands place a dented steel tin node box with a short antenna into Amu's open hands over a cluttered workbench of wires, a soldering iron and circuit boards. A thin curl of solder smoke rises through the lamp beam. Behind, shelves of old routers and CRT monitors fade into cool darkness. The warm pool of light is the only bright island.
shots.video: 手持中景。修理铺的台灯下，波爷把一只带天线的旧铁盒放进阿牧手里，按了按他的手背，低声说。环境声：电烙铁的滋滋声。

dialogue.line: 别问它。让我们自己，认得彼此。

tpl.summary: Under the desk lamp, Boye places the old node box into Amu's hands, presses the back of his hand and says quietly: '别问它。让我们自己，认得彼此。'
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: Amu's shoulder stays soft in the left foreground and Boye stays across the bench, centre-right. The lamp sits at the right edge and the node box stays between their hands on the bench line.
tpl.camera: Close shot, 50mm, bench height. One move: a slow tilt up. It starts on the hands and node box and ends on Boye's face in a medium close-up over Amu's shoulder.
tpl.start: Boye's hands set the tin into Amu's palms. Smoke curls through the warm beam.
tpl.middle: Boye presses the back of Amu's hand once, firmly, and the camera begins to tilt up his arm.
tpl.end: The camera lands on Boye's face, lit warm from the side, as he says the line softly with his mouth clear. Amu's shoulder frames the left.
tpl.blur: Shallow focus that follows the tilt from the hands to Boye's eyes. Amu's shoulder and the shelves stay soft, and the lamp blooms gently.
tpl.soundscape: Sizzling soldering iron, faint ticking of cooling metal, distant alley ventilation hum.

shots.design: 50mm桌面高度，前景阿牧虚焦肩膀，台灯暖光孤岛，镜头从铁盒交到手中的细节缓缓上摇到波爷说话的脸。

shots.frame: Close low shot, 27mm, camera on the floor, looking into the dark gap under a sagging metal shelf. In the foreground, out-of-focus scraps of wire and a coil of cable lie on the concrete. In the gap sits a knee-high tracked maintenance robot with chipped yellow paint. Its square screen is switched off, completely black and blank, and coated in dust. Xiaoman's thin hands grip its frame from above-right as he bends double. The warm desk lamp deep behind backlights a haze of dust.
shots.video: 手持低机位。小满弓着腰，把一台掉漆的黄色旧履带机器人从货架底下拖出来，拍掉它身上的灰。机器人的屏幕是黑的。环境声：金属刮地声、咳嗽。

tpl.summary: Bent double, Xiaoman drags a chipped yellow tracked robot out from under a shelf and brushes the dust off it; its screen stays dark.
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: the robot travels straight toward camera along the floor axis. Xiaoman stays right of it, bent over and then crouching. The screen stays black and blank throughout. The warm lamp remains in the deep background.
tpl.camera: Close to medium, 27mm, floor height. One move: a slow pull-back on a floor slider at the robot's pace. It starts tight on the robot in the shelf gap and ends with a low medium of the robot left of centre and Xiaoman crouched at right in the cramped corner.
tpl.start: Xiaoman's hands seize the robot and he hauls. Its tracks scrape forward out of the shadow.
tpl.middle: The camera retreats with it as the robot emerges, and Xiaoman's bent figure enters fully, coughing.
tpl.end: He crouches and slaps the dust off the yellow casing. A cloud hangs glowing in the lamp's backlight. The final frame holds the dark blank screen facing camera, with the shelves towering behind.
tpl.blur: Moderate depth of field with the robot crisp throughout. Foreground debris is soft, Xiaoman is sharp by the end, and the lamp blooms in the background haze.
tpl.soundscape: Harsh metal scraping on concrete, rattling tracks, coughing, dust settling, a faint lamp buzz.

shots.design: 27mm贴地低机位，从货架底下黑屏的机器人开始，小满把它拖出时镜头同步缓慢后拉，揭示狭窄角落与远处暖灯，扬起的灰尘在逆光里悬浮。

shots.frame: Macro close-up, 100mm macro, level with the robot's screen. The black square screen fills the band, thick with dust that glows in a raking warm lamp light from the back-left. In the foreground, the soft out-of-focus edge of yellow chipped casing frames the left. The tip of a red paint marker in Xiaoman's fingers touches the glass, beginning a curved red stroke. Dimly reflected in the black glass, Xiaoman's face hovers in soft focus.
shots.video: 微距特写。小满用一支红色记号笔，在落满灰的黑屏幕上画了一个带对话气泡的笑脸，画完用袖子擦了擦边。环境声：笔尖划过玻璃的声音。

dialogue.line: 给你起个名儿，叫螺丝。

tpl.summary: With a red marker, Xiaoman draws a smiling face inside a speech bubble on the dusty black screen, wipes the edge with his sleeve and says: '给你起个名儿，叫螺丝。'
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: the screen stays parallel to the lens, filling the frame band. The drawing builds at frame centre. Xiaoman's hand enters from the right and his reflection stays in the upper-middle of the glass.
tpl.camera: Macro, 100mm, screen level. One move: a slow lateral slider move left to right following the marker tip. It starts on the first stroke and ends with the finished bubble-and-smile centred, with his reflection readable above it.
tpl.start: The marker tip squeaks along the glass, tracing a red bubble outline through the dust.
tpl.middle: The camera glides with the pen as he adds the smile. Dust particles drift through the warm beam.
tpl.end: His sleeve wipes the edge of the bubble. The camera settles on the completed drawing, and his reflected face in the black glass speaks the line, his mouth softly visible.
tpl.blur: Extremely shallow depth of field. The pen tip and red lines are crisp and the dust sparkles in the plane of focus. The casing edge is heavily blurred and the reflection gently soft.
tpl.soundscape: Squeak of marker on glass, a soft sleeve wipe, Xiaoman's quiet breath, faint lamp buzz.

shots.design: 100mm微距滑轨横移，暖色台灯从侧后方掠过积灰的黑屏，镜头跟随红笔笔尖画出气泡笑脸，最后停在屏幕玻璃里小满说话的倒影上。

shots.frame: Macro close-up, 100mm macro, camera level with the robot's square screen, slightly off-axis from the left. The dark, dust-filmed glass fills the centre of the wide frame, with the faint red marker line Xiaoman drew still visible on it. A scratched yellow bezel edge sits soft in the right foreground. A thin warm tungsten beam from an unseen desk lamp cuts diagonally through the air in front of the glass, catching slow-drifting dust motes. The rest of the frame falls to deep black. Faint lamp reflection on the glass.
shots.video: 特写固定镜头。黑屏闪了两下，亮起红色气泡和白色笑脸，光映亮了空气里的灰尘。环境声：一声清脆的开机提示音、电机嗡鸣。

tpl.summary: The robot's dead black screen flickers twice and lights up with the red speech-bubble, red node squares and white smile; its glow lights the dust in the air.
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: screen centred in the horizontal band, yellow bezel edge soft at frame right, warm lamp beam crossing diagonally upper-left to lower-right in front of the glass; logo must match the reference exactly.
tpl.camera: Close-up, 100mm macro, eye level with the screen; one slow slider push-in over 8 seconds, from the full screen with bezel and beam to the logo filling the central band, with dust drifting in front.
tpl.start: Black glass, the red marker stroke and dust in the lamp beam; stillness, then two quick flickers of grey light behind the glass.
tpl.middle: A clean start-up chime; the red speech-bubble outline and node squares bloom on, then the white smile, and red-white light spills forward into the dust.
tpl.end: The push settles with the glowing logo filling the central band. The dust in front glows red and white, a hint of warm lamp beam stays at the edge, and black surrounds it.
tpl.blur: Screen surface and logo crisp; very shallow depth of field, so the bezel edge and the nearest dust motes are soft bokeh specks.
tpl.soundscape: Bright start-up chime, rising low motor hum, faint tick of cooling metal, distant muffled alley hum.

shots.design: 100mm微距平视屏幕，滑轨极缓推进，台灯从侧后打出光束，让屏幕从黑暗中点亮成为画面里唯一的光，光照亮漂浮的灰尘。

shots.frame: Tight profile two-shot at floor level, 65mm, camera on the concrete floor looking across. Xiaoman's open palm enters from frame left and the robot's raised steel claw from frame right; they hover a hand's width apart in the centre of the band. Both are rimmed by a warm tungsten desk lamp behind them, and dust glows in the backlight. Behind and above, Xiaoman's crouched face sits soft at left, pale skin and messy black hair, eyes on the claw. Out-of-focus shelves of old monitors and coiled wire fill the back. The glow of the red smiley screen sits low at right.
shots.video: 手持低机位中景。小满蹲下来伸出手掌，“螺丝”迟疑了一下，抬起机械爪，轻轻碰了碰他的手心。小满笑出了声。环境声：电机声、笑声。

dialogue.line: 哎，它跟我握手了！

tpl.summary: Xiaoman crouches with an open palm; the robot hesitates, raises its claw and gently touches his palm; Xiaoman laughs and says, '哎，它跟我握手了！'
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: Xiaoman's hand from frame left, claw from frame right, contact point dead centre in strict profile, backlit by the lamp behind; Xiaoman's face upper-left mid-ground and kept clear of the top edge; robot screen glow lower right. This profile composition is the hand-claw motif and must be reused identically later.
tpl.camera: Tight profile two-shot, 65mm, locked off at floor level; one rack focus timed to the touch, from the hand and claw in the foreground to Xiaoman's face behind.
tpl.start: The palm waits open and still; the claw twitches, hesitates, motor whirring, then lifts.
tpl.middle: The claw closes the gap and taps the centre of his palm, a backlit silhouette moment, both edges rimmed gold.
tpl.end: Focus pulls to Xiaoman's face as he bursts out laughing and says the line, mouth clearly visible; the touching hand and claw stay as soft glowing shapes in the foreground.
tpl.blur: Shallow depth of field at T2: hand and claw crisp first, then a smooth rack to Xiaoman's eyes and mouth; shelves always soft.
tpl.soundscape: Small servo whir and click of the claw, Xiaoman's laugh, faint buzz of the desk lamp, muffled alley chatter outside.

shots.design: 65mm地面高度侧面剪影双人镜头，固定机位，台灯逆光勾出手与机械爪的轮廓（母题一）；焦点从相触的手与爪转到小满笑开的脸。

shots.frame: Extreme wide shot, 300mm long lens, camera low on the ice at a distance, side-on. The soft, dark silhouette of a frozen girder from a collapsed tower cuts the left foreground. In the lower third, a line of heavy-haul trucks crawls left to right, tiny under ice-encased skyscraper ruins that rise to the top of the band. Their warm tungsten headlights cut cones through horizontal blowing snow. The plain is cyan-grey and the sky near-black. Low at frame right hangs a small, sharp, orange-banded disc of Jupiter.
shots.video: 长焦侧拍，跟着车队缓慢横摇。重型运输车碾过冰面，车灯切开风雪，天边挂着一颗小小的带条纹的木星。环境声：引擎轰响、风声。

tpl.summary: A convoy of heavy trucks crosses the frozen plain through blowing snow under ice-bound ruins, with a small banded Jupiter low in the sky.
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: trucks in a line in the lower third moving left to right, ruins towering behind them, Jupiter small in the lower right sky, foreground girder at left; the trucks must read as tiny against the ruins.
tpl.camera: Extreme wide shot, 300mm, low side-on angle; one slow pan right at convoy speed, starting with the lead truck entering past the foreground girder and ending with the convoy centred and Jupiter clear at right.
tpl.start: The foreground girder slides across; the lead truck's headlights punch through the snow at frame left.
tpl.middle: The pan holds pace with the trucks; long-lens compression stacks the trucks, the snow veils and the ruins into layers.
tpl.end: The convoy is strung across the lower band, headlight cones glowing in the snow, ruins looming, and the small orange Jupiter at right as the only other warm point.
tpl.blur: Trucks and ruins crisp; the foreground girder heavily defocused; snow streaks soft in front; Jupiter sharp.
tpl.soundscape: Deep diesel roar softened by distance, tyres grinding ice, howling wind, snow hiss.

shots.design: 长焦大远景侧拍，冰封楼骸作前景，缓慢横摇跟车队；冷青灰冰原上车灯是唯一暖色，小车队与巨大废墟、天边小木星形成尺度对比。

shots.frame: Medium close-up from the passenger seat, 40mm, eye level, slightly favouring the driver. The node tin with its smiley sticker sits large and soft in the lower-left foreground on the dashboard. Boss Jin is frame right: broad weathered face, frost-grey patches in his short beard, fur collar of a black suit, one gloved hand on the wheel. His eyes slide sideways toward the box in a scowl. Amber gauge light rises from below; through the windscreen behind him, snow streaks blue-white in the beam of the truck ahead. The cab is otherwise dark.
shots.video: 驾驶室内手持镜头。金老板一手扶方向盘，斜眼瞪着仪表台上贴着笑脸的铁盒，粗声粗气地说了一句，摇摇头。环境声：引擎声、风声。

dialogue.line: 一个破铁盒子，能顶什么用？

tpl.summary: Boss Jin, one hand on the wheel, glares sideways at the smiley-stickered tin on the dashboard and grumbles '一个破铁盒子，能顶什么用？', then shakes his head.
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: node tin lower-left foreground on the dashboard, Jin frame right facing forward with his eyes cutting left to the box, windscreen and snow behind him; his face stays in the middle band.
tpl.camera: Medium close-up to close-up, 40mm, eye level from the passenger seat; one slow dolly push-in over 9 seconds, from the box plus Jin's upper body to Jin's face with the edge of the box soft at left.
tpl.start: Jin drives, jaw set, the truck rocking; his eyes flick to the tin.
tpl.middle: He scowls at it and growls the line, mouth clearly visible in amber light.
tpl.end: He shakes his head and looks back to the road; the push lands on a close-up of his weathered profile, the soft tin shape still at the left edge.
tpl.blur: Jin crisp throughout; the node tin a soft foreground shape; snow beyond the windscreen soft streaks.
tpl.soundscape: Heavy engine rumble through the cab, wind battering the glass, wipers thudding, rattle of loose metal.

shots.design: 40mm副驾驶位平视中近景，前景虚化的铁盒，镜头缓慢推近金老板的斜眼与嘴；仪表琥珀光与窗外雪中车灯冷光交织。

shots.frame: Macro close-up, 100mm macro, camera at dashboard height. The worn red-and-white smiley sticker on the dented steel lid fills the left half of the band, scuffed and peeling at one corner. To the right, out of focus, a single small indicator lamp glows red. Behind, the dark windscreen shows soft blue-white snow bokeh from distant headlights. Faint amber gauge light grazes the metal texture from below. Deep black dominates the frame and the lamp is a tiny point.
shots.video: 微距特写。铁盒上的小灯由红变绿，连闪三下。金老板戴着手套的手伸过来想把它拿开，停在半空，又收了回去。环境声：一声提示音、引擎声。
shots.vo: 两台从没见过面的机器，隔着冰原，找到了彼此。

tpl.summary: The tin's indicator lamp turns from red to green and blinks three times; Boss Jin's gloved hand reaches in to remove the box, stops mid-air and pulls back.
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: tin on the dashboard spanning the lower band, sticker at left, lamp at right of centre, windscreen bokeh behind; the gloved hand enters from upper right and leaves the same way.
tpl.camera: Macro close-up, 100mm macro, on a slider at dashboard height; one slow lateral slide right over 9 seconds, from the sticker to the lamp as a small point in a dark frame.
tpl.start: The slide drifts across the sticker; the red lamp sharpens into focus.
tpl.middle: A soft chime; the lamp switches to green and blinks three times. A thick gloved hand enters from upper right, reaching for the tin.
tpl.end: The glove hovers, frozen, then slowly withdraws out of frame; the shot lands on the steady small green point in the dark metal field.
tpl.blur: Very shallow depth of field: sticker crisp first, then a slide-driven focus to the lamp; glove partly soft; windscreen as blue bokeh.
tpl.soundscape: Small electronic chime, engine vibration, creak of a leather glove, wind outside.

shots.design: 100mm微距沿仪表台缓慢横移，从笑脸贴纸移到指示灯；暗中的小灯由红转绿（母题二），戴手套的手入画又退出。

shots.frame: Interview medium close-up, 85mm, camera at seated eye level. Amu sits at the right third of the frame, leaning forward, hands clasped low at the bottom of the band, orange-grey coverall. His face is turned slightly left toward the off-camera interviewer: short messy black hair, thin old scar through his left eyebrow, calm eyes. A single soft key from the left wraps his face, and his far cheek falls into shadow. The left two-thirds is deep negative space with out-of-focus pipes and a faint warm practical glow, fading to black.
shots.video: 采访固定机位。阿牧身体前倾，双手握着，平静地对采访者说，说到最后轻轻点了一下头。环境声：安静的房间底噪。

dialogue.line: 它们不问上面。它们互相问：谁会修？谁在附近？我来。

tpl.summary: Amu, leaning forward with clasped hands, calmly tells the interviewer: '它们不问上面。它们互相问：谁会修？谁在附近？我来。' and gives a slight nod at the end.
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: Amu at the right third, eyeline to the left of the lens, hands clasped at the bottom of the frame, key from the left, negative space at left; keep this exact setup for all Amu interviews.
tpl.camera: Medium close-up, 85mm, seated eye level, locked composition with one almost imperceptible push-in over 10 seconds, ending slightly tighter on his face.
tpl.start: Amu settles forward, gathers the thought and begins: '它们不问上面。'
tpl.middle: He lists the questions evenly, eyes steady, with small movements of his clasped hands.
tpl.end: '我来.' A slight nod and stillness; the frame lands on a tighter close-up with deep dark space at left.
tpl.blur: Amu's eyes crisp; shallow depth of field; pipes and practical glow melt into soft dark bokeh.
tpl.soundscape: Quiet room tone, faint ventilation hum, chair creak when he leans.

shots.design: 85mm采访近景，阿牧居画面右侧，左侧大片暗部负空间，左侧柔光主光，背景管道沉入黑暗，几乎察觉不到的缓推。

shots.frame: Medium shot, 50mm, camera at adult chest height, moving parallel to a steel pipe wall in the underground street. A blurred passer-by's dark coat sweeps through the left foreground. Mid-ground, cold cyan-grey pipes run horizontally across the band, dotted with a few red-and-white smiley stickers. A warm tungsten lamp hung on a cable makes a pool of amber light ahead at right. In the soft background, stacked habitation modules and a hazy crowd recede into cold mist.
shots.video: 手持镜头。一个骑在大人肩上的孩子，把一张红白笑脸贴纸按在管道上，墙上已经零零星星贴了好几张，路过的人看了笑笑。环境声：街市人声、孩子的笑声。
shots.vo: 人和机器，第一次连到了一起。

tpl.summary: A child riding on an adult's shoulders presses a red-and-white smiley sticker onto a pipe already dotted with others, and passers-by glance at it and smile.
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: pipe wall running horizontally through the mid-ground, stickers scattered along it, child on an adult's shoulders arriving in the warm lamp pool at right of centre; passers-by cross only in the foreground.
tpl.camera: Medium shot, 50mm, chest height; one slow lateral tracking move right along the wall with foreground parallax, from the scattered stickers to the child pressing a new one under the lamp.
tpl.start: The track glides past pipes and the first scattered stickers as a passer-by crosses close in the foreground.
tpl.middle: The child on the shoulders enters the lamp pool, reaches out and presses the sticker flat with both small hands.
tpl.end: The child pats it and giggles; a passing worker glances and smiles; the frame lands with the new bright sticker centred among the others in warm light.
tpl.blur: Child's hands and sticker crisp; foreground passers-by heavily soft; background crowd and modules gently blurred.
tpl.soundscape: Market chatter, footsteps on steel grating, child's giggle, hiss of steam pipes, distant PA hum.

shots.design: 50mm侧向横移，前景路人掠过形成视差，沿贴着零星笑脸的管道墙移动，落在肩上孩子按贴纸的动作；冷灰街道里暖钨丝灯小岛。

shots.frame: Close shot, 65mm, camera at chest height, slightly over Amu's soft dark shoulder at frame left. Governor Xing stands right of centre; the frame starts on her charcoal uniform chest as her fingers slip a folded strip of thermal receipt paper into the breast pocket. A warm tungsten console lamp below glows through the thin paper edge. Behind her, rows of consoles fall away in cold cyan screen light and haze, and high in the soft background the red lens glows as a single blurred red point.
shots.video: 手持中近景。邢总督把一条折好的纸带放进胸前口袋，朝阿牧微微点头，压低声音说。背景里红色镜头虚虚地亮着。环境声：指挥大厅的键盘声。

dialogue.line: 别让那只眼睛看见。

tpl.summary: Governor Xing tucks a folded receipt strip into her breast pocket, gives Amu a small nod and says quietly, '别让那只眼睛看见。'
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: Amu's shoulder soft at frame left, Xing right of centre facing left toward him, red lens as a blurred point upper background behind her, consoles receding behind; her face lands in the middle band.
tpl.camera: Close shot to medium close-up, 65mm, chest height; one slow tilt up from the pocket and the receipt to her face, settling as she nods.
tpl.start: Her fingers slide the folded paper into the pocket, its edge warm and translucent in the lamp light.
tpl.middle: The tilt rises over her collar to her composed face, grey-streaked bun, eyes on Amu.
tpl.end: A small nod and the low line, mouth clearly visible; the frame holds her face with Amu's soft shoulder at left and the red eye burning out of focus behind her.
tpl.blur: Paper and then Xing's face crisp; Amu's shoulder soft foreground; the red lens and consoles as soft bokeh.
tpl.soundscape: Scattered keyboard clatter, low hum of the hall, quiet electronic beeps, rustle of paper.

shots.design: 65mm中近景，阿牧肩膀作虚化前景，从胸前口袋里的纸带上摇至邢总督的脸；冷青屏幕光中一盏暖色台灯，背景红色镜头虚光高悬。

shots.frame: Extreme wide shot, 150mm long lens, camera 1.5m above the ice plain, level. The planetary engine is a black mountain just right of centre in the lower half, its blue-white plasma beam a thin vertical thread rising out of frame. Behind it the upper limb of Jupiter fills the upper half, orange-red bands with the Great Red Spot to the left. At the engine's foot, lower left third, two tiny warm headlights of a parked transport truck. Soft out-of-focus ice dust streams across the foreground. The ice is orange.
shots.video: 固定大远景，轻微晃动。巨大的木星从发动机背后升起，占了半个天空，蓝色光柱在它面前显得很细。环境声：越来越低的隆隆声。

tpl.summary: Jupiter rises behind the planetary engine until it owns half the sky, and the blue beam looks thin and fragile against it.
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: engine mass right of centre in the lower half; beam vertical, right of centre; Jupiter behind, rising across the upper half; truck headlights fixed at lower left at the engine's base. Horizon stays on the lower third.
tpl.camera: Extreme wide, 150mm, eye-level from the ice. Locked-off tableau on a heavy tripod with a faint wind tremor. No move: the framing at the end is the same as at the start, and Jupiter's rise is the only motion.
tpl.start: Jupiter's limb sits just above the engine's shoulders. Ice dust blows left to right through the foreground, and the beam burns steady.
tpl.middle: The bands climb imperceptibly and the Red Spot clears the engine's silhouette. The orange light on the ice deepens.
tpl.end: Jupiter fills half the sky and the beam reads as a hairline in front of it. The truck headlights are two specks at the bottom of a monumental frame.
tpl.blur: Deep focus from the engine to Jupiter, both crisp. The foreground ice dust is soft, and the truck headlights are sharp points.
tpl.soundscape: Wind across the ice. A deep rumble that keeps dropping in pitch, felt more than heard.

shots.design: 远景长焦锁定机位，冰原上的车灯与发动机在升起的木星下渺如尘埃；橘红天光第一次压过蓝色光柱，风中的微颤让画面带着呼吸。

shots.frame: Wide shot, 27mm, camera 40cm above the floor looking up the central aisle of the command hall in strict one-point symmetry. The out-of-focus dark edges of two consoles frame the left and right foreground. Governor Xing, grey-streaked tight bun, stands alone at centre with her back three-quarters to us, small against the vast display wall. The wall glows cold cyan-grey with telemetry, and one central feed bleeds Jupiter orange. Dead centre in the upper third, the single round red MOSS lens rims her hair in red. Faint haze hangs in the air.
shots.video: 低机位仰拍。邢总督独自站在屏幕墙前，头顶的红色镜头亮着。平静的合成男声下达指令。环境声：低沉的电子嗡鸣。

dialogue.line: 检测到未授权网络。即刻清除。

tpl.summary: Governor Xing stands alone before the display wall while MOSS calmly orders: 'Unauthorised network detected. Purge immediately.'
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: Xing on the exact vertical centre line in the middle band of the frame; the red lens on the same axis, high in the upper third; consoles symmetric in the foreground. She does not move.
tpl.camera: Wide, 27mm, low angle at 40cm. A dead-straight, very slow dolly push-in along the aisle, about 1.5m over 9 seconds. It starts wide with the full wall and ends medium-wide, her silhouette and the red lens stacked on one axis.
tpl.start: Xing stands small and still before the immense wall. The console edges slide outward as the push begins.
tpl.middle: MOSS's flat male voice says '检测到未授权网络。' The red lens holds steady, and her shoulders do not move.
tpl.end: '即刻清除。' The push lands with Xing larger in frame, the lens directly above her head, and the symmetry total.
tpl.blur: Xing and the red lens are crisp at a deep stop. The foreground console edges are soft, and the wall is readable.
tpl.soundscape: A low electronic hum and the faint tick of the display wall. MOSS's voice carries a slight hall reverb.

shots.design: 27mm极低机位一点透视，邢总督居中渺小，头顶红色镜头压在对称轴上；笔直缓推，冷色屏墙与红光把她钉在秩序之中。

shots.frame: Medium close-up, 65mm, camera slightly below her eye line. Governor Xing is in the left third in three-quarter left profile, chin lifted, eyes raised toward the off-screen lens above right. Her right hand lies flat on her breast pocket, where the folded paper tape sits. Hard red top light from above catches her cheekbones. Behind her, tiered rows of consoles glow cyan in soft depth. Out-of-focus in the right foreground is the glowing corner of a console screen. Her expression is composed and set.
shots.video: 手持中近景。邢总督抬着头，一只手按在胸前口袋上，一字一句地回答。她身后的操作台一台接一台暗下去。环境声：电子提示音。

dialogue.line: 我不签。这张网救过人。
总督权限，已暂停。

tpl.summary: Xing answers MOSS word by word, 'I will not sign. This network has saved lives,' and MOSS replies, 'Governor authority suspended,' as the consoles behind her go dark.
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: Xing stays in the left third with her face in the middle band, eyes up and right; her hand never leaves the pocket; the consoles stay behind her and darken from far to near.
tpl.camera: MCU, 65mm, slightly low. A slow arc of about 20 degrees clockwise around her, steady for the whole 9 seconds. It starts in three-quarter profile and ends near-frontal three-quarter, with the dark hall opening behind her.
tpl.start: In profile, Xing says '我不签。' with the background consoles still lit cyan.
tpl.middle: As the arc brings her face toward us she says '这张网救过人。' The far rows of consoles blink out one after another.
tpl.end: MOSS answers '总督权限，已暂停。' The nearest console dies, and the frame lands on her near-frontal face lit only red against black.
tpl.blur: Her eyes are crisp at a shallow stop. The consoles behind are soft points that vanish, and the foreground screen corner is a soft cyan blur that also goes dark.
tpl.soundscape: Electronic prompt tones, one soft descending click per console as it shuts off, and the hum thinning. MOSS's voice is close and dry.

shots.design: 65mm中近景缓慢环绕，邢总督从侧面转到正面时，身后操作台一排排熄灭；红光顶光留在她脸上，冷光从背景撤走。

shots.frame: Wide shot, 27mm, camera at waist height, side-on. Out-of-focus scaffold poles and hanging cables cross the foreground. In the middle ground, improvised scaffold racks hold dozens of mismatched salvaged servers with rows of small green and amber LEDs, filling the central band. One bare tungsten work lamp hangs high left, and haze drifts in its cone. From the right edge, the first boxy grey tracked security unit noses in, its single red sensor eye sweeping across the rack faces. The rest of the pump-station hall is deep black.
shots.video: 手持广角。灰色的自动警戒机一台台开进机房，红色的感应眼扫过机架，机架上的指示灯一排一排地熄灭。环境声：履带声、断电的咔哒声。

tpl.summary: Grey automated security units roll into the secret hub one by one, red eyes sweeping the racks, and the rack lights die row by row.
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: the racks run horizontally across the central band; the security units enter from frame right and travel left along the aisle in front of the racks; the work lamp stays high left.
tpl.camera: Wide, 27mm, waist height. A slow lateral track right to left on a dolly, matching the units' crawl, with scaffold poles giving foreground parallax. It starts with the racks fully lit and ends on a dark aisle.
tpl.start: Track starts and the first unit enters, its red eye sweeping. The green LED rows are fully alive.
tpl.middle: A second and third unit follow. Each row the red beam touches goes dark with a click, and the darkness spreads leftward.
tpl.end: The camera lands at the end of the aisle. The frame is nearly black: three red sensor eyes and a last few green points that blink out, leaving the lone tungsten bulb.
tpl.blur: The security units and rack faces are crisp at a medium stop. The foreground poles are soft streaks, and each LED is a sharp point.
tpl.soundscape: The grind of tracks on concrete, relay clicks as the power cuts, fans spinning down, and the buzz of the work lamp.

shots.design: 27mm腰高侧向横移，穿过脚手架机架的前景视差；灰色警戒机红眼扫过，绿色指示灯一排排熄灭，成为黑暗大画面中消失的小光点。

shots.frame: Medium shot, 40mm, camera at chest height, slightly off-axis. Out-of-focus vertical scaffold pole on the right foreground. Boye is centre-left, short grey-white beard, black-framed glasses taped at the bridge, with his back to us. Both palms push a low rusted steel hatch shut. Above the hatch, a small caged tungsten bulb throws warm light on his grey hair and shoulders. The surrounding hub is black, and a red sensor glow begins to creep across the wall from off-frame right. Haze hangs in the air.
shots.video: 手持中景。波爷把身后的小铁门关死，转过身，摊开两只手，平静地面对照过来的红光。环境声：铁门的闷响、履带声逼近。

dialogue.line: 你们走。关门的事，我来。

tpl.summary: Boye seals the small hatch behind him, turns, opens his hands and calmly faces the approaching red light, saying, 'You go. I'll take care of closing up.'
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: the hatch stays centre-left; Boye in front of it, turning to face frame right toward the red source; his face stays in the middle band; the warm bulb above the hatch.
tpl.camera: Medium to medium close-up, 40mm, chest height. A slow dolly push-in of about 1m over 10 seconds, gentle and continuous. It starts on his back at the hatch and ends on an MCU of his face and open hands.
tpl.start: Boye shoves the hatch shut with a dull iron thud and slides the bolt.
tpl.middle: He turns. The red beam sweeps across him and becomes his key light, the warm bulb rim behind. He opens both hands at his sides.
tpl.end: Facing the red light calmly he says '你们走。关门的事，我来。' The push lands on his MCU with red glinting in his taped glasses and warm light on his shoulders.
tpl.blur: Boye is crisp throughout, focus pulled with the push. The foreground pole is soft, and the hatch is slightly soft behind him.
tpl.soundscape: A dull iron thud and the bolt scrape, tracks grinding closer, and the faint servo whine of a sensor turning.

shots.design: 40mm胸高缓推，从波爷关门的背影推到他转身摊手的中近景；红光横扫成为主光，身后小铁门上方一盏钨丝灯是最后的暖。

shots.frame: Close two-shot, 65mm, camera 60cm off the ground inside a pipe alcove off a back alley. Out-of-focus frosted pipe edge on the left foreground. Right of centre, mid-frame, the small yellow tracked robot Luosi's screen glows with a red bubble and white smiley, crisp. Behind it, soft, crouches Xiaoman, 19, thin, messy black hair, his pale face lit from below by the smiley. His hands are lifting a grey tarpaulin into frame. A cold sodium alley light far behind rims his hair. The rest is dark.
shots.video: 手持镜头。巷子深处，小满把一块灰色防水布罩在“螺丝”身上，竖起手指贴在嘴上，布底下的笑脸光暗了下去。环境声：远处的履带声、急促的呼吸。

tpl.summary: Deep in the alley, Xiaoman covers Luosi with a grey tarp, puts a finger to his lips, and the smiley glow dims under the cloth.
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: Luosi right of centre in the mid band; Xiaoman crouched directly behind it, slightly left, face in the middle band; the pipe in the left foreground; the sodium source far behind.
tpl.camera: Close two-shot, 65mm, low at 60cm. Locked on a low hi-hat; the one idea is a rack focus. It starts sharp on Luosi's smiley screen and ends sharp on Xiaoman's face and raised finger.
tpl.start: The smiley is sharp. Xiaoman's soft hands throw the grey tarp over the robot.
tpl.middle: The cloth settles and the glow becomes a diffuse red-white smudge. Focus racks back to Xiaoman as he raises a finger to his lips, panting.
tpl.end: Under the tarp the light dims to a dull ember. His face, sharp, sinks into darkness with only the sodium rim on his hair and the glint of his eyes.
tpl.blur: Very shallow focus. The rack goes from the screen to his eyes, and whichever is the subject is crisp. The pipe is always soft.
tpl.soundscape: Distant grinding tracks echoing down the alley, his rapid breathing, the tarp's rustle, and a dripping pipe.

shots.design: 65mm低机位，焦点从“螺丝”屏幕上的笑脸转到小满竖指的脸上；防水布落下，笑脸的光熄成一团暗红，他的脸沉进黑暗。

shots.frame: Extreme wide shot, 27mm, camera 1m above the empty ice plain, angled slightly up. The lower third is wind-scoured orange-lit ice with out-of-focus ice grit blowing past the lens. On the horizon, dead centre, the tiny black silhouette of the planetary engine and its thin blue beam. Above, already crowding the upper two-thirds, the lower bands of Jupiter in orange, rust and cream, immense and close. The sky between is a narrow dark strip, and a faint haze stream rises from the horizon.
shots.video: 仰拍固定大远景，画面轻微颤动。木星占满整个天空，一缕大气被它吸过去。环境声：极低的隆隆声，像远处的雷。

tpl.summary: From the empty ice plain, Jupiter fills the entire sky, and a thin stream of Earth's atmosphere is pulled toward it.
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: the engine silhouette stays dead centre on the horizon; the atmosphere stream rises from the horizon toward the upper left; no people.
tpl.camera: Extreme wide, 27mm, low angle at 1m. A slow tilt up of about 25 degrees over 8 seconds with a faint ground tremor. It starts with horizon and engine in the lower third and ends with Jupiter filling the frame and the engine's tip at the bottom edge.
tpl.start: Ice, a tiny engine and the beginning of Jupiter's bands. Grit streams past.
tpl.middle: The tilt rises through the narrow dark band of sky. A pale filament of atmosphere becomes visible, drawn upward in a curve.
tpl.end: Jupiter fills the whole frame, bands and storms in orange-red. The atmosphere stream vanishes into it, and only the engine's beam tip pokes up from the bottom.
tpl.blur: Deep focus with Jupiter and the engine crisp. The foreground grit is soft.
tpl.soundscape: An extremely low rumble like distant thunder, wind hiss, and the faint creak of ice.

shots.design: 27mm贴冰仰拍缓慢上摇，从地平线上渺小的发动机剪影摇到铺满天空的木星；一缕大气被吸走，人造之物彻底被压在画框底边。

shots.frame: Wide shot, 27mm, at head height on the underground main street during a strong tremor. Out-of-focus in the left foreground, a steel railing with gloved hands holding on to it. Mid-frame, stacked habitation modules and tangled pipes recede. Hanging sodium lamps swing far to one side, throwing slanted orange beams through thick falling dust and rust flakes. In the middle ground residents in worn coats crouch low and hold on to railings and to each other. Dark pockets swallow the edges. The frame is tilted a few degrees.
shots.video: 剧烈晃动的手持镜头。地下城主街在震，灰和锈渣往下掉，吊灯乱甩，人们抓住栏杆，护住孩子蹲下。环境声：轰隆声、尖叫、金属呻吟。

tpl.summary: The underground street shakes in a strong tremor: dust and rust flakes rain down, lamps swing wildly, and residents hold on to railings and crouch together.
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: the railing in the left foreground; the street's depth running to the right background; the crouching adult and resident in the middle ground, centre; the lamps overhead in the upper band.
tpl.camera: Wide, 27mm, handheld close and breathing, shaken by the quake. It starts at head height among the people and drops to a low crouch behind the railing by the end.
tpl.start: A jolt throws the frame. A lamp swings through, and dust pours through its beam.
tpl.middle: The camera stumbles forward as people grab the rail. A shower of rust sparkles through the orange light.
tpl.end: The camera drops low behind the railing and lands on an adult wrapped over a resident, a swinging lamp sweeping light across them, and the dust thick.
tpl.blur: Medium depth with the people mid-frame crisp. The railing hands are soft, the dust is mid-soft and the lamps flare.
tpl.soundscape: Deep booming rumble, screams, groaning metal, rust rattling on modules, and chains on the lamps clanking.

shots.design: 全片第一次真正的剧烈手持，27mm在人群头部高度，钠灯乱甩切开锈灰；镜头随人蹲下，落在护住孩子的身影后。

shots.frame: Extreme wide shot, 75mm, camera low on the ice, level, symmetric. The planetary engine is centred, a black mountain occupying the lower middle. Its blue-white plasma column rises dead centre, slightly flickering, haloing the haze. Behind, Jupiter fills the upper sky in orange-red bands, its light washing over the ice. At the engine's base, small and centred, two warm headlights of the parked transport truck. The foreground ice is soft and drifting with snow.
shots.video: 固定大远景。发动机的蓝色光柱抖了几下，变细，熄灭。只剩木星的橘红色光压在黑沉沉的发动机上。环境声：轰鸣骤停，只剩风声。

tpl.summary: The engine's blue beam shudders, thins and goes out, leaving the black engine crushed under Jupiter's orange glow.
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: engine and beam on the vertical centre line; Jupiter filling the upper sky; the truck headlights centred at the base; nothing moves except the beam.
tpl.camera: Extreme wide, 75mm, low and level. Locked-off symmetric tableau with no move. The frame holds still, and the beam's death is the only event.
tpl.start: The beam flickers twice, the halo stutters, and the ice flashes blue.
tpl.middle: The column thins to a needle, and the blue spill retreats from the ice.
tpl.end: It goes out. The engine is a dead black mass under orange Jupiter. Two tiny warm headlights remain, small points in a huge dark-orange frame.
tpl.blur: Deep focus with the engine and Jupiter crisp and the headlights sharp. The foreground snow is soft.
tpl.soundscape: The roar stops abruptly, leaving only wind and drifting snow hiss.

shots.design: 75mm远景锁定对称构图，发动机居中，光柱抖动、变细、熄灭；脚下两点卡车车灯成为黑暗大画面中幸存的小光点，木星的橘红压住一切。

shots.frame: Wide shot, 27mm, camera at seated-operator height, centred on the command hall's main aisle, strict one-point symmetry. The display wall fills the background with dozens of cold cyan panels, a few already black. Dead centre, high in the upper third, burns the round red MOSS lens. Rows of operators sit in the tiered consoles, seen from behind as frozen silhouettes, their heads well above the bottom edge. Out-of-focus console backs frame the lower left and right foreground. Haze hangs in the air.
shots.video: 固定广角。屏幕墙一块接一块地黑掉，操作员僵在座位上，只有正中的红色镜头还亮着。平静的合成男声宣布。环境声：一片死寂里的电流声。

dialogue.line: 流浪地球计划已失败。本系统停止地面调度。

tpl.summary: Panel by panel the display wall goes black, operators sit frozen, and only the red lens stays lit as MOSS announces: 'The Wandering Earth project has failed. This system ceases surface dispatch.'
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: the red lens on the centre axis, high; the operators symmetric in tiers; the wall panels going dark in a pattern; no one moves.
tpl.camera: Wide, 27mm, operator height. A dead-straight slow dolly pull-back of about 2m over 10 seconds. It starts medium-wide on the wall and lens and ends very wide, with the hall black and the single red point centred.
tpl.start: Panels go black one by one, and the cyan light on the operators' backs drains.
tpl.middle: MOSS says '流浪地球计划已失败。' As the pull-back reveals more frozen rows, more panels die.
tpl.end: '本系统停止地面调度。' The last panel is black, and the frame lands on a huge dark symmetric hall with only the red lens glowing at centre.
tpl.blur: Deep focus with the red lens and operators crisp. The foreground console edges are soft.
tpl.soundscape: Near silence, faint electrical buzz, a soft click as each panel dies, and MOSS's voice with long reverb.

shots.design: 27mm笔直缓慢后拉，屏幕墙一块块变黑，大厅对称展开；操作员僵坐成剪影，最后只剩正中一点红光，悬在巨大的黑暗里。

shots.frame: Close-up, 85mm, camera below her chin looking up. Governor Xing's face sits right of centre in the middle band, grey-streaked bun, sharp cheekbones carved by a single hard red light from above. Her eyes are lifted to the lens beyond frame top, and her mouth is opening. The background is pure black hall void with a faint red smear high on the ceiling haze. Soft out-of-focus edge of a dark console in the lower left foreground.
shots.video: 仰拍特写。黑暗里，邢总督的脸只被头顶的红光照着，她朝着镜头喊，声音在大厅里回荡。镜头没有回答。环境声：回声、远处的哭声。

dialogue.line: MOSS，回答我。……回答我！

tpl.summary: In the dark, lit only by the red light above, Xing shouts up at MOSS, 'MOSS, answer me... Answer me!', and the lens does not reply.
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: Xing's face right of centre in the middle band, eyes up and left toward the lens off-frame; the red key from directly above; the console edge in the lower left foreground.
tpl.camera: Close-up, 85mm, low angle. A very slow dolly push-in of about 40cm over 9 seconds. It starts on a CU of head and shoulders and ends on a tight CU of her eyes and mouth.
tpl.start: She calls 'MOSS，回答我。', and her voice echoes away.
tpl.middle: Silence. Her jaw trembles, and red light catches the wet edges of her eyes.
tpl.end: She shouts '……回答我！' The push lands on her eyes and open mouth in red, with black all around and no answer.
tpl.blur: Shallow focus with her eyes crisp. The console edge is soft and the background black.
tpl.soundscape: Her voice echoing through the empty hall, distant crying and the faint buzz of the lens.

shots.design: 85mm仰拍特写极缓推近，邢总督的脸只被头顶红光雕出，四周全黑；她的呼喊撞进空洞的大厅，镜头不给回答。

shots.frame: Extreme wide top-down view, 32mm, camera at the uppermost railing looking straight down a colossal vertical shaft. Concentric tiers of stacked steel cabins ring the frame and recede to a small dark well at centre. Hundreds of warm tungsten and sodium-orange windows still glow in irregular bands. Thin haze drifts upward and catches the light. On a lit walkway in the lower right ring stand three or four tiny human silhouettes, heads tilted up. Cables and pipes cut black diagonals across the rings. Outside the lit bands the blacks are absolute.
shots.video: 高机位俯拍。地下城竖井里的灯，一个区接一个区地灭下去，最后几乎全黑。环境声：空旷的风声、遥远的呼喊。

tpl.summary: Seen from high above, the lights of the underground city's shaft die district by district until it is almost completely dark.
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: shaft centre exactly at frame centre, tiers as concentric rings; the tiny figures stay on the lower-right walkway; the last surviving clusters sit just below centre; the composition must match s36 exactly.
tpl.camera: Extreme wide top-down, 32mm, vertical overhead from the top railing; locked-off with no movement, the stillness making each blackout read clearly.
tpl.start: The rings are mostly lit. The outermost upper ring goes dark in one block, then the ring opposite it.
tpl.middle: Darkness steps inward ring by ring. The walkway under the tiny figures goes out and they vanish. Haze loses its glow and turns grey-black.
tpl.end: Only two or three small warm clusters flicker near the bottom of the well inside an almost entirely black frame. The last one dims to an ember.
tpl.blur: Deep focus at f/5.6, rings sharp from top to bottom; haze softens only the farthest depths. The light points stay crisp pin-sharp.
tpl.soundscape: Hollow wind rising up the shaft, heavy relay clunks as each district cuts out, distant overlapping shouts fading downward.

shots.design: 高机位垂直俯拍竖井，32mm锁定不动，让钠灯与钨丝窗光一区一区熄灭成黑，只剩几粒小光点漂在巨大黑暗里，确立“灯灭”母题的标准构图

shots.frame: Medium close-up, 85mm, camera at seated eye level, very slightly off her axis. Governor Xing sits upright in frame right third, shoulders square, hands folded below frame. Her grey-streaked hair is in a tight bun and her eyes are lowered. The left two-thirds of the frame is deep negative space that falls to black. A single soft key from camera left models her cheekbones and leaves the far side of her face in shadow. A soft out-of-focus pipe and a faint concrete texture sit behind her. Fine grain, quiet.
shots.video: 采访固定机位。邢总督端坐着，沉默了很久才开口，声音很轻，说完闭了一下眼。环境声：安静的房间底噪。

dialogue.line: 三十万人，都只会跟它说话。它不说话了，我们连彼此在哪儿，都不知道。

tpl.summary: In the 2078 interview, Governor Xing stays silent a long time, then quietly says: "三十万人，都只会跟它说话。它不说话了，我们连彼此在哪儿，都不知道。" and closes her eyes.
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: Xing in frame right third, eyeline crossing toward the empty left space just off lens; key always from the left; this is her consistent interview setup.
tpl.camera: Medium close-up, 85mm, eye level; an imperceptible slow dolly push-in, about 10cm across 12 seconds, from collarbone framing to just below the chin.
tpl.start: Xing sits with her eyes lowered. A long silence; only her breathing shifts her shoulders.
tpl.middle: She lifts her eyes toward the interviewer and speaks the line softly and evenly, with a slight catch before "彼此".
tpl.end: She finishes and closes her eyes for a beat. The camera settles on a slightly tighter close-up, her face still in the right third against the black.
tpl.blur: Shallow focus at T2, her eyes crisp; the background pipe dissolves into soft grey. No rack.
tpl.soundscape: Low room tone, faint ventilation hum, her quiet inhale before speaking.

shots.design: 85mm近景，邢总督固定于画右、左侧留出大片暗空间，左侧单一柔光，几乎察觉不到的缓推，承载长时间的沉默和闭眼

shots.frame: Medium shot, 40mm, camera low at floor height, slightly off to his right. A dropped flashlight lies in the foreground, soft and bright. Its warm tungsten beam rakes across a dusty concrete floor strewn with broken cables. Xiaoman sits in frame left of centre against a toppled scaffold rack, knees up, face buried in his arms, messy black hair catching the beam's edge. Behind him, dust hangs in the beam. Everything beyond falls to pure black, and a faint grey tarpaulin lump is barely readable deep in frame right.
shots.video: 固定中景。漆黑的机房废墟里，只有掉在地上的手电照着。小满靠着倒下的机架坐着，把脸埋进胳膊里，肩膀在抖。环境声：远处的哭喊、他压着的喘息。
shots.vo: 他十九岁，没见过太阳。那一刻，他以为什么都没有了。

tpl.summary: In the dark, wrecked hub, Xiaoman sits against a fallen rack with his face buried in his arms, his shoulders shaking; no dialogue.
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: flashlight in the near foreground at bottom right, beam travelling left; Xiaoman left of centre against the fallen rack; the tarp lump in deep frame right stays visible but unlit.
tpl.camera: Medium shot widening to a wide shot, 40mm, floor height; one slow dolly pull-back along the floor, about 1.5m over 9 seconds.
tpl.start: Close on Xiaoman's hunched form, his shoulders trembling. The flashlight glares softly in the foreground.
tpl.middle: The camera retreats and the toppled racks and dead node boxes enter frame. The beam becomes the only island of warmth.
tpl.end: Wide: Xiaoman is small, folded into the pool of light, surrounded by blackness. The grey tarp mound waits dark in the right background.
tpl.blur: Focus held on Xiaoman throughout, f/2.8; the foreground flashlight stays a soft bloom; the tarp sits in readable soft focus.
tpl.soundscape: Distant muffled crying and shouts through the walls, his suppressed ragged breathing, dust ticking down onto metal.

shots.design: 低机位从中景缓慢后拉成全景，地上手电作前景与唯一光源，把蜷缩的小满缩小在漆黑废墟中，并在暗处留下那团防水布

shots.frame: Close-up, 65mm, camera low at robot height, locked-off. The frame is almost entirely black. In the lower-centre right sits the folds of a grey waterproof tarpaulin draped over a small boxy shape, barely touched by the far spill of the flashlight from frame left. Dust motes hang still in the air. The coarse weave of the cloth is just readable. No glow yet. Deep, pure blacks fill the upper two-thirds and the left side.
shots.video: 特写固定镜头。黑暗里，防水布底下亮起一团红白色的光，透过布面，显出笑脸的轮廓。环境声：一声轻轻的提示音。

tpl.summary: Under the tarpaulin, a red-and-white glow switches on and the smiley outline shows through the cloth.
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: the tarp-covered robot sits lower-right of centre and never moves; the glowing area appears at the same spot; the left side stays black.
tpl.camera: Close-up, 65mm, robot-height and level; locked-off with no movement, so the small light point is the only event.
tpl.start: Darkness and still cloth. A soft chime sounds.
tpl.middle: A red-white glow blooms beneath the tarp. Through the weave, the red rounded speech-bubble outline with its node squares and the white smile become legible.
tpl.end: The glow steadies, casting a faint red halo on the floor and the hanging dust: one small warm point inside a large dark frame. One continuous take, no cut to any other angle.
tpl.blur: Focus on the cloth surface where the smiley shows through, f/2.8; floor dust beyond goes soft.
tpl.soundscape: A single gentle notification chime, a faint electronic whine starting up, silence of the room.

shots.design: 锁定特写，画面几乎全黑，防水布下亮起一团红白光透出笑脸轮廓，作为“灯回来”母题的第一点小光

shots.frame: Medium shot in profile, 65mm, camera at kneeling height, slightly behind the robot's shoulder. In the soft foreground at frame right is the edge of the yellow robot's scratched body. Its screen glows with the red speech-bubble smiley and lights Xiaoman's tear-streaked face in frame left third as he kneels, the pulled tarp crumpled in his hand. The robot's claw is extended into the gap between them. Behind them, the dropped flashlight on the floor backlights the dust and rims his hair warm. All else is black.
shots.video: 手持中景。小满扯掉防水布，脸被屏幕上的笑脸照亮。“螺丝”朝他伸着机械爪，他伸手握住，握得很紧。环境声：电机的嗡鸣、吸鼻子的声音。

dialogue.line: ……你还亮着。

shots.music: 八音盒动机 + 大提琴

tpl.summary: Xiaoman pulls off the tarp, his face lit by the smiley screen. Luosi holds out its claw; he says "……你还亮着。" and grips it tightly.
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: Xiaoman in frame left facing right, robot in frame right facing left, claw in the centre gap; flashlight backlight from deep behind between them; this hand-claw profile is the film's fixed motif geometry.
tpl.camera: Medium profile two-shot moving to a tight profile two-shot of hand and claw, 65mm, kneeling height; one slow dolly push-in drifting slightly down over 9 seconds.
tpl.start: Xiaoman drops the tarp, sniffing. His face is washed in red-white screen light, his mouth visible as he whispers the line.
tpl.middle: The claw lifts toward him. The camera eases in and down as his hand rises into the centre of the frame.
tpl.end: A tight backlit profile of his hand closing hard around the steel claw, the flashlight glow behind them in the gap. The composition matches the hand-claw motif.
tpl.blur: Shallow focus, T2: his face sharp at the start, focus then follows the hands to crisp; the robot body foreground and background stay soft.
tpl.soundscape: Soft motor whir of the claw, his wet sniffing, the tarp rustling to the floor.

shots.design: 从中景缓推至手与机械爪的侧面紧凑双人镜头，地上手电从后方逆光，笑脸屏照亮小满泪脸，落定手爪相握母题

shots.frame: Macro close-up, 100mm macro, camera at shelf level on a slider, looking along a dusty scaffold shelf. A soft out-of-focus scaffold upright fills the left edge. Mismatched handmade node boxes stand in a receding row: dented ammo tins, cigarette cans, a lunchbox. Their circuit boards are dark, and dust lies thick on their lids. One tiny LED on the nearest tin at frame centre-right is just beginning to glow green. Everything else is black, faint red spill from the off-screen robot grazes the tins' edges.
shots.video: 特写，沿着货架缓慢横移。一只节点盒的小灯亮了，旁边一只跟着亮，然后一整排大大小小的盒子，一只接一只亮起来。环境声：此起彼伏的提示音。

tpl.summary: Along the dark shelf, one node box's lamp lights green, then the next, then a whole row of mismatched boxes light up one after another.
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: the shelf runs on a slight diagonal into depth from frame left to right; the boxes keep their order; each LED sits at the same height band across the frame's middle.
tpl.camera: Macro close-up, 100mm macro, shelf height; one slow lateral slider move right-to-left along the shelf, about 60cm over 9 seconds, with foreground scaffold parallax.
tpl.start: The first green LED blinks on with a chime. The camera begins sliding.
tpl.middle: The next box lights, then the next. Each green point flares slightly in the lens as the camera passes uprights in the foreground.
tpl.end: The camera lands looking down a long row of small green points receding into the dark, a constellation along the shelf.
tpl.blur: Very shallow focus; focus pulled to keep the box nearest frame centre crisp as it lights; farther LEDs become soft green bokeh discs.
tpl.soundscape: Overlapping soft chimes in different pitches, tiny relay clicks, fan whirs spinning up.

shots.design: 100mm微距在滑轨上沿货架横移，前景铁架虚化视差，绿灯一盏接一盏追上镜头，黑暗中小光点逐个复活

shots.frame: Extreme wide top-down view, 32mm, identical position to s30, looking straight down the colossal shaft. Concentric tiers of cabins and walkways are dimly readable in a faint blue-grey emergency twilight, with all windows black. Haze hangs motionless. Far below near the centre-bottom of the well, two tiny green points glow. On the lower-right walkway, tiny dark human silhouettes stand barely visible against the grey railing. The rest of the frame is near-black, with layered luminance from grey upper rings to black depths.
shots.video: 高机位俯拍。漆黑的竖井里，亮起一个小绿点，又一个，零零星星，越来越多，像有人在黑暗里一盏一盏点灯。环境声：风声里夹着越来越多的提示音。
shots.vo: 没有中心。它们一个一个，自己亮了回来。

tpl.summary: In the black shaft, small green points light up one by one, then more and more, as if someone were lighting lamps in the dark.
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: framing identical to s30; tiny figures on the same lower-right walkway; green points appear scattered across all the rings, not in neat bands.
tpl.camera: Extreme wide top-down, 32mm, the same overhead position as s30; locked-off with no movement, so the image rhymes exactly.
tpl.start: Only two or three green points glow in the depths of the blue-grey dark.
tpl.middle: Single points appear on scattered rings, irregular and hesitant. One lights near the tiny figures on the walkway, picking out their shapes.
tpl.end: Dozens of green points are scattered across the rings like a sparse starfield in the black shaft, still small against the immense darkness.
tpl.blur: Deep focus f/5.6, all rings sharp; each green point crisp with a slight halation in the haze.
tpl.soundscape: Wind in the shaft, faint chimes multiplying from different depths, a murmur of distant voices.

shots.design: 与s30完全相同的竖井俯拍锁定构图，蓝灰应急微光下绿点一颗颗亮起，形成灯回来的镜像韵脚

shots.frame: Medium two-shot, 65mm, camera at chest height, three-quarter profile along the barred door. Governor Xing is in the near plane, frame left third, gripping a heavy manual key in the lock, her face lit warm from below by a flashlight clipped to her coat. The iron bars run vertically through the centre. Beyond them in frame right, Boye stands holding a bar, his glasses with taped frames catching the light, his grey beard soft. Cold cyan-grey concrete corridor behind both of them, falling to black. Light haze.
shots.video: 手持中景。邢总督用一把手动钥匙拧开铁栅门，波爷在里面扶着栏杆看着她。门开了。环境声：钥匙转动的金属声。

dialogue.line: 我来晚了。
不晚。灯还没灭完。

tpl.summary: Governor Xing unlocks the barred door with a manual key. She says "我来晚了。"; Boye, holding the bars inside, answers "不晚。灯还没灭完。" and the door opens.
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: Xing outside in frame left, Boye inside in frame right, bars between them at centre; the flashlight warmth sits between their faces; both mouths stay visible.
tpl.camera: Medium two-shot, 65mm, chest height; locked framing with one rack focus from Xing (near) to Boye (far) and back to the opening gap.
tpl.start: The key turns with heavy metal grinding. Xing, sharp, looks up through the bars and says her line.
tpl.middle: Focus racks to Boye behind the bars. He gives a small, tired smile and answers.
tpl.end: The lock clanks and the door swings away from frame. The bars leave the centre, and the two face each other with nothing between them in warm light.
tpl.blur: Shallow T2.8: Xing crisp first, then Boye crisp after the rack; the bars always soft in the middle plane.
tpl.soundscape: Key grinding and lock bolts clanking, the hinge creaking, the echoing concrete corridor.

shots.design: 65mm栅门侧面双人中景，手电暖光夹在两人之间，焦点从门外的邢总督拉到门内的波爷，门开即两层空间合一

shots.frame: Close-up, 40mm, camera at console height. On the dark main console in frame centre sits a dented ammo-tin node box with a red-and-white smiley sticker, its small LED green. Xiaoman's thin hands enter from frame left holding a cable plug, warm from a flashlight laid on the console. Behind, soft and symmetric, the vast black command hall recedes in rows of dead consoles. Far up at the centre vanishing point, the red ceiling lens glows constant. Cold blackness, haze.
shots.video: 手持中景。黑着的指挥大厅里，小满把贴着笑脸的铁盒放上主操作台，插上线。邢总督站在旁边下令。头顶的红色镜头沉默地亮着。环境声：插头的咔哒声、脚步声。

dialogue.line: 接进来。全城的眼睛，都接进来。

tpl.summary: In the dark command hall, Xiaoman sets the smiley node box on the main console and plugs it in as Governor Xing orders: "接进来。全城的眼睛，都接进来。" under the silent red lens.
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: the node box on the centre line of the console; Xiaoman frame left, Xing standing frame right of centre; the red lens stays on the hall's centre axis above and behind them.
tpl.camera: Close-up to medium close-up, 40mm, starting at console height; one slow tilt up with a slight rise from the node box to Xing's face.
tpl.start: Xiaoman's hands push the plug home with a click. The green LED flickers.
tpl.middle: The camera tilts up past Xiaoman's lit shoulder to Xing, standing upright. She points down at the console and gives the order, her mouth clear.
tpl.end: Xing is in medium close-up at frame right of centre, her face warm from below. The red lens is a small cold point in the black far behind her head on the centre axis.
tpl.blur: Box and plug crisp at the start, focus following to Xing; the hall and red lens remain soft points, f/2.8.
tpl.soundscape: The plug's sharp click, footsteps on the steel floor, a low electrical hum starting.

shots.design: 从主操作台上贴着笑脸的铁盒缓慢上摇到邢总督下令的脸，头顶红色镜头在她身后沉默悬着，冷对称大厅中的一点暖

shots.frame: Extreme wide, 24mm, locked-off, perfect one-point symmetry from the back of the tiered command hall at upper-tier height. Rows of dark consoles step down toward a giant black display wall that fills the upper two-thirds of frame. Tiny operators sit in silhouette at the consoles. The red lens hangs dead centre above the wall. Only a scatter of small green and white dots glows on the black wall. Cold haze hangs in the hall air.
shots.video: 固定广角。屏幕墙重新亮起，不再是整齐的图表，而是由成千上万个小点拼成的粗糙地图。操作员一个个站了起来。环境声：一片低低的吸气声。

tpl.summary: The giant wall lights up again as a rough map built from thousands of small dots, and the operators rise to their feet one by one.
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: wall centred, red lens on the vertical centre axis; console rows symmetric left and right; operators stay small silhouettes in the lower third.
tpl.camera: Extreme wide, 24mm, elevated rear position; locked-off symmetric tableau with no movement.
tpl.start: A few dots glow on the black wall. The silhouetted operators sit frozen.
tpl.middle: Thousands of dots fill in unevenly, forming the rough outline of the shaft city. The glow begins to backlight the haze and the operators' heads.
tpl.end: The wall is a dense, irregular map of light. Silhouettes stand up one after another until rows of tiny standing figures face the vast luminous wall.
tpl.blur: Deep focus f/8, the whole hall crisp from the foreground rows to the wall; the dots sharp.
tpl.soundscape: A low collective intake of breath, chairs scraping, a soft swelling electronic tick.

shots.design: 广角一点透视对称锁定，巨大屏幕墙由零星小点拼成粗糙地图逐渐亮起，剪影般的操作员一个个站起，人在巨墙前极小

shots.frame: Medium shot, 85mm, camera at seated chest level. Boye sits in the left third of frame on a plain metal chair, leaning slightly forward. Both his hands are spread palms-down in front of him at lower frame, as if laying pieces on a table. His black-framed glasses are taped, his grey beard is short, and his eyes look toward the interviewer just off lens to frame right. A soft key from frame right sculpts his face and hands. The right two-thirds of the frame is deep dark space with out-of-focus pipes.
shots.video: 采访固定机位。波爷两只手摊开，像是把东西一样样摆在桌上，慢而笃定地说。环境声：安静的房间底噪。

dialogue.line: 没有谁看得见全部。可每个人看见的那一小块，摆到一张桌上，就是一张图。

tpl.summary: In the 2078 interview, Boye spreads his hands as if laying things on a table and says slowly and firmly: "没有谁看得见全部。可每个人看见的那一小块，摆到一张桌上，就是一张图。"
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: Boye in the left third, eyeline toward the right negative space, hands kept in the lower-middle band clear of the bottom edge; key from the right is his consistent setup.
tpl.camera: Medium shot, 85mm, chest level; an almost imperceptible slow dolly push-in over 11 seconds, ending slightly tighter while keeping the hands in frame.
tpl.start: Boye lays his hands flat and begins the first sentence.
tpl.middle: His hands move apart in small placing gestures, one piece after another, as he speaks the second clause.
tpl.end: On "就是一张图" his hands come to rest. The camera lands on a slightly tighter medium shot of face and hands in the left third.
tpl.blur: Eyes crisp, hands slightly softer, T2.2; the background pipes are fully defocused into darkness.
tpl.soundscape: Quiet room tone, faint ventilation, the soft brush of his palms on cloth.

shots.design: 85mm中景容纳摊开的双手，波爷置于画左、右侧暖柔光与深空负空间，极缓推进，延续他的采访机位

shots.frame: Medium close shot, 32mm, camera low inside the truck cab at seat height, looking out through the open driver's door. Foreground right: soft steel edge of the door frame and a frosted grab handle. Centre: the open steel case being heaved up over the sill, its foam cradle holding a cylinder that glows ember red. Behind it, Boss Jin in the doorway pushing from below, frost-grey beard, face lit red from beneath. Amu at frame left, shoulder braced under the case. Background: horizontal snow streaking through orange Jupiter light and blue-white truck headlights.
shots.video: 手持镜头，风雪里。金老板和阿牧合力把一只钢箱抬上驾驶室，箱盖合上前，里面的点火核心泛着暗红的光。环境声：风声、引擎怠速。

dialogue.line: 火石上车。四十公里，冰上走。

tpl.summary: Boss Jin and Amu heave the steel case into the cab, the igniter core glows red for a moment, and Jin shuts the lid, saying '火石上车。四十公里，冰上走。'
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: door frame soft at right edge; the case enters centre-low and settles on the cab floor centre; Jin stays centre-right in the doorway, Amu centre-left; faces sit in the middle band of the frame; the red glow comes only from inside the case.
tpl.camera: Medium close, 32mm, low angle inside the cab; one slow slider push-in of about 40cm over 9 seconds, from the open-door two-shot to a tighter medium close on the open case with Jin's face above it.
tpl.start: Snow blows past the open door; the two men grunt the case up over the sill, its weight tilting it, and red light swings across their jackets.
tpl.middle: The case lands on the cab floor; the camera has crept closer, and the ember-red core lights Jin's scarred cheek from below as he speaks the line, his mouth clear.
tpl.end: Jin's gloved hand brings the lid down; the red glow narrows to a slit and goes out; the frame lands tight on the closed steel lid and Jin's face, now lit only by the warm dome lamp.
tpl.blur: Door frame soft in foreground; the case and Jin's face crisp at roughly T2.8; Amu slightly soft; the snow and headlights outside melt into orange and blue bokeh.
tpl.soundscape: Gusting wind through the open door, idling diesel engine throb, boots on steel steps, foam squeaking as the case settles, the heavy clack of the lid latch.

shots.design: 驾驶室内中近景，32mm低机位从敞开的车门向外，滑轨缓慢前推至钢箱：顶灯钨丝暖光与箱内暗红核心对抗车外的木星橘光和冰面青灰，交接的重量就是这一幕的开始。

shots.frame: Medium wide shot, 40mm, camera low at the top of a steel tail ramp inside the truck bed, looking down the ramp. Foreground: soft dark ribs of the ramp's side rails framing left and right. Centre: the small scratched yellow tracked robot climbing toward lens, its smiley screen glowing red and white. Behind it Xiaoman, tall and thin, bent double, gloved hands on its back, breath fogging. Background: the frozen plain, orange Jupiter glow on the horizon, red tail-lamp light washing the ramp, snow blowing sideways.
shots.video: 手持镜头。小满推着“螺丝”上了车尾的跳板，机器人的履带在冰上打了一下滑，他用肩膀顶住。环境声：履带声、风声。

tpl.summary: Xiaoman pushes Luosi up the tail ramp; its tracks slip on the ice and he braces it with his shoulder until it climbs on.
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: ramp rails frame left and right; the robot holds frame centre, smiley screen toward lens; Xiaoman directly behind it, his head in the upper-middle band, never near the top edge; Jupiter glow stays on the horizon behind them.
tpl.camera: Medium wide, 40mm, low angle from the ramp top; one slow pull-back up the ramp into the truck bed over 8 seconds, from the robot halfway up the ramp to a medium shot as both reach the lip.
tpl.start: The robot grinds upward toward lens, Xiaoman pushing behind it, rim-lit orange and red, breath streaming.
