tpl.middle: Its tracks spin on a glaze of ice and it slides back a few centimetres; Xiaoman drops his shoulder into its back and digs in, his face straining over the robot's head.
tpl.end: The tracks bite and it rolls up over the lip; the camera settles with the robot's glowing screen in the lower centre and Xiaoman behind it, catching his breath against the orange sky.
tpl.blur: Ramp rails soft in the foreground; the robot and Xiaoman crisp; the plain and horizon fall into soft orange; ice crystals sparkle in the tail-lamp light.
tpl.soundscape: Rattling tracks on ribbed steel, a sharp skid and whine of the motor, Xiaoman's grunt, wind, the idling truck.

shots.design: 低机位40mm从车尾货舱口沿跳板向下，缓慢后拉，让小满和“螺丝”迎着镜头往上爬；红色尾灯和木星橘光勾出逆光轮廓，呼气白雾可见。

shots.frame: Extreme wide shot, 65mm, locked off from a slight rise, camera at eye height. Foreground: soft dark ridge of wind-carved ice across the lower edge. Middle: a thin line of twelve heavy transport trucks crossing the frozen plain from left toward centre, each pair of headlights a tiny white point, a red speck at each tail. Background: ice-encased skyscraper ruins as small black silhouettes, and above them Jupiter filling the upper half of the frame, its banded orange surface bleeding light across the snow.
shots.video: 固定大远景。十二台重型运输车排成一线，开进木星的橘红色光里，车灯小得像火星。环境声：引擎的合鸣、风声。
shots.vo: 饱和式救援。每一台停机的发动机，都有车队在赶去。

tpl.summary: The twelve-truck convoy rolls in a line across the ice plain into Jupiter's orange light, its headlights tiny as sparks.
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: the convoy line sits in the lower third, moving left to right; Jupiter fills the upper half; the ruins are a dark serrated band on the horizon; the ice ridge stays soft at the lower edge.
tpl.camera: Extreme wide, 65mm, eye level; locked-off tableau, no movement for 9 seconds; the convoy's motion carries the shot.
tpl.start: The lead truck's headlights enter the plain from frame left; the rest follow in a thin chain.
tpl.middle: The full line of twelve stretches across the lower third, tiny white points cutting through drifting ground snow under the vast orange disc.
tpl.end: The lead vehicles have reached frame centre, swallowed by the orange haze; the composition rests on the long dotted line beneath the planet.
tpl.blur: Deep focus at T8; the foreground ice ridge slightly soft; the convoy and the ruins crisp; Jupiter sharp but softened by atmospheric haze.
tpl.soundscape: A distant layered chorus of heavy engines, wind sweeping over the ice, faint creaking of the ice sheet.

shots.design: 固定的超大远景，木星占据上半画面，十二台运输车成一条细线横穿冰原下方，车灯小如火星；用宏大的尺度压住出发的这一刻。

shots.frame: Medium close shot, 27mm, handheld from the passenger seat at dashboard height, angled toward the driver. Foreground left: the dented steel node box on the dashboard, its small lamps flashing rapidly, a red-and-white smiley sticker on its lid, soft. Middle: Boss Jin gripping the wheel with both hands, beard frosted, jaw clenched, eyes on the road. Background: the windscreen filled with orange Jupiter light, headlight beams raking churning snow and a dark seam in the ice ahead. Cab interior dim, lit by the dashboard and the flashing lamps.
shots.video: 剧烈晃动的驾驶室内镜头。仪表台上的铁盒急促地闪灯，金老板猛打方向盘向左，整个人被甩得一歪。环境声：急促的提示音、引擎嘶吼。

dialogue.line: 前面裂了！它让我们往左！

tpl.summary: The node box flashes urgently; Boss Jin wrenches the wheel hard left and is thrown sideways, shouting '前面裂了！它让我们往左！'
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: the node box stays in the left foreground; Jin holds the centre-right of the middle band; the windscreen spans the background; his face never drops below the lower third, even when thrown.
tpl.camera: Medium close, 27mm, dashboard height; one handheld move, shaking hard with the cab, absorbing the jolt as Jin swings left and ending tighter on his face.
tpl.start: The cab shudders; the node box lamps blink frantically in the foreground; Jin's eyes dart from the box to the windscreen.
tpl.middle: He hauls the wheel to the left; the whole cab lurches; the camera swings with the force and the orange windscreen slides across the frame; he is thrown hard toward the door.
tpl.end: He shouts the line, mouth clear, straining against the turn; the frame lands on his face in medium close, the flashing box a soft green-red smear at the left edge.
tpl.blur: Node box soft in the foreground with lamp bokeh; Jin's face crisp; the windscreen scene in soft orange; motion blur from the shake allowed only at the frame edges.
tpl.soundscape: Rapid electronic warning beeps, the engine roaring under load, tyres grinding on ice, a deep crack of the ice under the cab, the creak of the steering column.

shots.design: 驾驶室内27mm手持近景，剧烈颠簸：铁盒急闪的灯在前景、金老板在中景、挡风玻璃外的橘光与冰裂在背景，危急之中第一次真正放开手持。

shots.frame: Wide shot, 150mm, locked off and rigged facing backward from the rear of a moving truck, vibrating with the chassis. Large dark frame: the shadowed ice plain fills most of the image, a dim orange sky glow only along the top band. Middle distance, slightly right of centre: two small white headlight points of the last truck, its bulk barely readable in blowing snow. Between camera and truck, a jagged black fissure begins opening across the ice. Snow particles streak past the lens in the foreground, soft.
shots.video: 长焦镜头，晃动。车队后方的冰面裂开，最后一台车的车灯一歪，沉下去，消失在腾起的雪雾里。环境声：冰层断裂的巨响。

tpl.summary: The ice splits behind the convoy and the last truck's headlights tilt, drop and vanish into a rising cloud of snow.
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: the two headlight points stay right of centre in the middle band; the fissure runs horizontally across the lower-middle of the frame; the frame is mostly dark ice with a thin orange glow at the top.
tpl.camera: Wide, 150mm, rear-facing at chassis height; locked off on the truck, vibrating with the vehicle, no operator move for 8 seconds.
tpl.start: Two headlight points follow steadily in a dark field; a thin black crack zips across the ice between us and them.
tpl.middle: The crack splits wide; the two points tilt sideways, one dropping below the other.
tpl.end: The lights sink and go out inside a billowing white snow cloud; the frame rests on dark ice and settling powder where the points were.
tpl.blur: Long-lens compression; focus held on the headlight points and fissure, crisp; foreground snow streaks soft; the shake comes from the vibrating rig only.
tpl.soundscape: A thunderous crack of breaking ice, a long grinding groan, rushing snow, the rumble of our own truck underneath.

shots.design: 长焦固定在车尾随车身震动，在大片暗冰面上只留下最后一台车的两点车灯，看它们歪斜、下沉、熄灭，呼应全片的“灯灭”母题。

shots.frame: Close-up, 85mm, camera at eye level beside the driver's window, angled back toward the cab. Foreground left: the side rear-view mirror, crisp, showing dark ice and drifting snow with no headlights. Right of centre, soft: Boss Jin's broad weathered face in three-quarter, frostbite scars on his cheek, beard frosted, a battered radio handset clenched to his mouth, knuckles white. Orange Jupiter light through the side glass rims his face; faint green dashboard glow from below. Darkness behind him in the cab.
shots.video: 手持特写。金老板死死攥着对讲机，盯着后视镜，对着话筒喊。对讲机里只有电流声。环境声：电流杂音、引擎声。

dialogue.line: 七号车！老秦！回话！

tpl.summary: Boss Jin grips the radio handset and stares into the mirror, shouting '七号车！老秦！回话！', but only static answers.
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: the mirror holds the left foreground; Jin's face holds the right of centre in the middle band; the handset stays at his mouth throughout, mouth visible beside it.
tpl.camera: Close-up, 85mm, eye level; one rack focus from the mirror (foreground) to Jin's face (background) at the start of his line; no camera movement.
tpl.start: The mirror is sharp: dark ice, snow, no lights; Jin is a soft orange shape behind it.
tpl.middle: Focus racks to Jin as he presses the transmit key and shouts the line, veins in his neck, mouth clear beside the handset.
tpl.end: He releases the key; only static hisses back; he holds absolutely still, eyes locked on the mirror, which is now a soft dark smear in the foreground.
tpl.blur: Shallow T2; first the mirror crisp and Jin soft, then Jin crisp and the mirror soft; the background of the cab falls to black.
tpl.soundscape: Engine drone, a hiss and crackle of empty radio static, the click of the transmit key, wind against the glass.

shots.design: 85mm驾驶室内特写，从后视镜里空荡的雪雾拉焦到金老板嘶喊的脸，镜中无光，脸上只有仪表盘微光和木星橘光。

shots.frame: Medium shot, 85mm, camera at seated eye level. Boss Jin sits on a plain metal chair in the right third of the frame, body angled slightly left, a walking cane laid across his knees, both hands resting on it. A soft key from frame left falls on his weathered face and frost-grey beard; the right side of his face sinks into shadow. His eyes are red-rimmed and wet, looking past the lens to the left. The left two-thirds is dark negative space: out-of-focus pipes and concrete dissolving into black.
shots.video: 采访固定机位。金老板膝上横着一根拐杖，眼眶是红的，望着镜头外，说得很慢，说完抹了一把脸。环境声：安静的房间底噪。

dialogue.line: 十二台车出去，八台到。老秦没到。

tpl.summary: In the 2078 interview, Boss Jin, cane across his knees, says slowly '十二台车出去，八台到。老秦没到。' and then wipes his face with his hand.
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: Jin is fixed in the right third, his eyes on the upper-middle line; negative space on the left; the cane horizontal at the lower edge; this setup is Jin's for the whole film.
tpl.camera: Medium shot, 85mm, eye level; one almost imperceptible slow push-in over 10 seconds, from a medium shot with the cane visible to a medium close where the cane just leaves the bottom edge.
tpl.start: Jin sits in silence, eyes wet, gaze resting past the lens; his hands are still on the cane.
tpl.middle: He speaks the line slowly, with a pause before the last sentence, his mouth clear in the soft key.
tpl.end: He lifts one hand and drags it down over his face; the frame lands in medium close, his hand lowering, eyes still off to the left in the dark.
tpl.blur: Shallow T2; Jin's eyes crisp; the cane falls slightly soft as we push; the background pipes are diffuse shapes melting into black.
tpl.soundscape: Quiet room tone, a faint ventilation hum, the creak of the metal chair, his breath catching.

shots.design: 85mm采访中景，金老板居右，向左留出大片暗色负空间，左侧柔光单灯，几乎察觉不到的缓推，让沉默和数字一起落下。

shots.frame: Wide shot, 40mm, locked off at low height on the ice plain, frame vibrating. Foreground: soft chunks of frosted debris at the lower edge. Centre-left: the base of the dead planetary engine, a dark wall of steel and concrete rising out of frame, its nozzle cold. At its foot, a thin steel relay mast stands beside a square shaft opening. Far right: a parked transport truck with blue-white headlights and two tiny figures beside it. Jupiter's orange light floods the sky and the ice; dust and ice haze hang in the air.
shots.video: 固定远景，画面震动。停机的发动机脚下，一根中继桅杆折断倒下，冰块和混凝土滑下来，埋住了井口。环境声：坍塌的轰响。

tpl.summary: At the foot of the stopped engine, a relay mast snaps and falls as ice and concrete slide down and bury the shaft opening.
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: the engine wall fills the left two-thirds; the mast and shaft opening sit centre-left at its foot; the truck and two tiny figures stay far right, small; the horizon line is low.
tpl.camera: Wide, 40mm, low angle; locked-off tableau for 8 seconds, shaking only with the ground tremor.
tpl.start: Ice dust trickles from the engine's flank; the mast sways against the orange sky.
tpl.middle: The mast buckles at its base and topples sideways; a sheet of ice and broken concrete slides down the engine wall.
tpl.end: The avalanche buries the shaft opening in rubble and a rolling dust cloud; it settles to a dim orange haze, the tiny figures and truck still far right.
tpl.blur: Deep focus at T5.6; the engine base, mast and shaft crisp; the foreground debris soft; the dust cloud diffuses the background light.
tpl.soundscape: A shriek of tearing steel, a thunderous roar of sliding ice and concrete, a deep ground rumble, the wind returning as the dust settles.

shots.design: 固定远景，熄火的发动机如山般压满画面，远处停着的卡车和两个小人提供尺度，中继桅杆在木星橘光中折断，冰与混凝土倾泻而下，埋住井口。

shots.frame: Close shot, 40mm, camera low at crouch height, angled slightly down. Foreground right: Xiaoman's shoulder and arm, soft and dark. Centre: Amu's gloved hands holding the dented steel node box, every small lamp on it dark. Snow dust drifts across it. Background: a heap of broken concrete and ice choking the shaft mouth, and beyond it the dark wall of the stopped engine. Orange Jupiter light from above, cold blue-white truck headlight raking from the left across the frost.
shots.video: 手持镜头。被碎石堵住的井口边，阿牧蹲着，手里的节点盒灯全灭了。他抬头看了一眼发动机，对小满说。环境声：风声、碎石滚落声。

dialogue.line: 中继断了。下面听不见我们。

tpl.summary: Amu crouches by the buried shaft holding a node box with all its lights out, looks up at the engine, and tells Xiaoman '中继断了。下面听不见我们。'
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: Xiaoman's soft shoulder holds the right foreground; Amu holds the centre-left; the rubble and engine fill the background; Amu's face settles in the middle band after the tilt.
tpl.camera: Close, 40mm, low angle; one slow tilt up from the dark node box in his hands to Amu's face over about 4 seconds, then held.
tpl.start: The dark node box fills the centre; his thumb presses a switch; nothing lights.
tpl.middle: The camera tilts up with his gaze as he lifts his face to the engine towering above, the eyebrow scar catching the headlight, breath fogging.
tpl.end: He turns his head toward Xiaoman and speaks the line, mouth clear, the frame resting on his face between the soft shoulder and the dark engine.
tpl.blur: Shallow T2.8; first the node box crisp, then Amu's face crisp; Xiaoman's shoulder soft; the engine and rubble a soft dark mass.
tpl.soundscape: Wind, small stones and ice clattering down the rubble pile, the dry click of the dead switch, breath.

shots.design: 40mm从熄灭的节点盒特写缓慢上摇至阿牧抬起的脸，身后巨大的停机发动机模糊成黑墙，小满作前景虚化肩膀，橘光与卡车冷光交织。

shots.frame: Medium shot, 32mm, camera very low, about 30cm above the ice, three-quarter behind the robot. Foreground right: the small scratched yellow tracked robot, its smiley screen glowing, antenna raised. Middle left: Xiaoman standing, coat whipped by wind, head turned toward Amu off frame. Background left: a pile of fallen concrete slabs with one narrow, pitch-black gap. Orange Jupiter light overhead, blue-white truck headlight grazing the rubble, ice dust drifting through the beams.
shots.video: 低机位手持。“螺丝”原地转过身，屏幕对着碎石间一道漆黑的窄缝，停住了。身后的小满慢慢转过头，明白了它要做什么。环境声：电机转动声、风声。

tpl.summary: Luosi turns on its tracks to face a narrow black gap in the rubble and stops; behind it Xiaoman slowly turns his head and understands what it means to do.
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: the robot stays in the foreground at low frame centre-right; the black gap is centre-left; Xiaoman is mid-ground left, his face in the middle band; the robot's screen faces the gap by the end.
tpl.camera: Medium, 32mm, ground level; one slow arc of about 60 degrees to the left around the robot over 9 seconds, ending low behind its shoulder looking into the gap.
tpl.start: The robot sits still; Xiaoman, behind it, looks away toward Amu.
tpl.middle: The robot pivots on its tracks to the gap as the camera arcs with it; its screen light spills red and white onto the slabs.
tpl.end: The robot stops, screen squared to the black slit; in the mid-ground Xiaoman slowly turns his head, his face catching the red glow, the dawning understanding in his eyes.
tpl.blur: Robot crisp in the foreground; Xiaoman in focus at T4 with gentle falloff; the gap a sharp black void; the far engine soft.
tpl.soundscape: The whir of a small electric motor, crunch of tracks turning on ice, wind, trickling grit.

shots.design: 32mm贴地低机位绕“螺丝”缓慢弧移，它原地转身朝向黑缝，屏幕的红白光渗入黑暗；小满在后景慢慢转头，脸被这团光照亮。

shots.frame: Medium close shot, 27mm, handheld low at knee height, side-on, very close. Foreground: ice chips spraying from the robot's spinning tracks, soft. Centre: Xiaoman on his knees, arms locked around the robot's yellow body from behind, face pressed against its back, mouth open in a shout, breath vapour. The robot pulls toward the right of frame where the black gap waits. Orange Jupiter light from above, blue-white headlight from behind them rimming his hair and the fog.
shots.video: 手持镜头。小满扑上去从后面抱住“螺丝”的机身，脚跟蹬着冰面往回拽，朝它喊。环境声：履带空转的摩擦声、风声。

dialogue.line: 不行！你回来！会压碎的！

tpl.summary: Xiaoman throws his arms around Luosi from behind, heels digging into the ice to drag it back, shouting '不行！你回来！会压碎的！'
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: the robot pulls toward the right, the black gap off frame right; Xiaoman is centre-left wrapped around it; his face stays in the middle band, mouth visible over the robot's back.
tpl.camera: Medium close, 27mm, knee height; one handheld move, close and breathing, jolted by the struggle, tightening as he shouts.
tpl.start: He lunges into frame and clamps his arms around the robot; it keeps grinding toward the gap.
tpl.middle: His heels gouge the ice; tracks spin and spray chips; the camera shakes with every tug as he shouts the line, face contorted.
tpl.end: Both strain in a stalemate; the frame lands tight on his face pressed against the yellow casing, breath fogging, the screen glow in red on his cheek.
tpl.blur: Xiaoman's face crisp at T2.8; flying ice chips soft; the robot's casing sharp near his face; background falls into orange and black.
tpl.soundscape: Screeching tracks spinning on ice, a straining motor, grinding ice chips, his ragged breath and shout, wind.

shots.design: 27mm贴身手持侧拍，惊慌中的唯一一次挣扎：小满从背后死死抱住“螺丝”，脚跟蹬冰，冰屑飞溅，嘶喊的脸压在画面中线。

shots.frame: Close-up, 100mm, camera at hand height, strict profile. Foreground band: Xiaoman's gloved hand resting in the lower middle of the frame, palm down, soft; the robot's small steel claw just entering from the right, soft. Background, slightly higher, in focus: Xiaoman's face in three-quarter, tears and frost on his lashes, lit red and white by the robot's smiley screen, which has turned to face him. Orange Jupiter light backlights the hand and claw, rimming the knuckles and steel edges; deep black elsewhere.
shots.video: 特写。“螺丝”停了下来，屏幕转过来对着小满的脸。它抬起机械爪，在他的手套上轻轻碰了一下，然后松开。环境声：电机的轻响，风声忽然远了。

tpl.summary: Luosi stops, turns its screen to Xiaoman's face, lifts its claw and gently touches his glove, then lets go.
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: the hand-and-claw profile two-shot holds the lower middle band, hand from left, claw from right; Xiaoman's face is above and behind, centred left; backlight from Jupiter behind the hand and claw, matching every hand-and-claw shot in the film.
tpl.camera: Close-up, 100mm, hand height, profile; locked off with one rack focus from Xiaoman's face in the background to the hand and claw in the foreground, timed to the touch.
tpl.start: The robot's screen glow falls on Xiaoman's face, crisp in the background, his breath stilling; the hand and claw are soft shapes in front.
tpl.middle: Focus racks forward as the claw rises and rests lightly on the back of his glove, both outlined in orange backlight.
tpl.end: The claw lingers a beat, then opens and withdraws out of frame right; the frame holds on his empty glove, crisp, his face soft behind.
tpl.blur: The robot's claw touching the glove in the foreground and Xiaoman's face stay readable; one gentle rack focus only; the frame never goes fully soft.
tpl.soundscape: A soft electric motor whir, a faint tap of metal on fabric, the wind suddenly receding into a distant hush, his held breath.

shots.design: 100mm侧面逆光紧双人镜头（全片“手与爪”母题机位）：从后景被屏幕照亮的小满的脸拉焦到前景机械爪轻触手套，风声远去。

shots.frame: Low wide shot, 40mm, camera 30 cm above the frozen rubble, directly behind the small knee-high yellow tracked robot. Out-of-focus chunks of broken concrete frame the left and right edges of the foreground. The robot sits centre-left, its scratched boxy body seen from behind, whip antenna upright. Its screen spills a red-white glow forward onto a tilted concrete slab that fills the upper two-thirds of the frame. Beneath the slab, a black horizontal gap waits at the centre. Faint orange Jupiter light rims the slab's top edge. Ice dust drifts through the glow.
shots.video: 手持镜头，从背后拍。“螺丝”开进了石板底下的窄缝，天线刮着混凝土，身上的光一点点没进黑暗里。环境声：履带声、金属刮擦声。

tpl.summary: The little robot Luosi drives into the narrow gap under a tilted slab, its antenna scraping concrete, and its light disappears into the dark.
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: robot always seen from behind, centred on the gap; the slab is a heavy dark mass across the upper frame; the gap is a horizontal black slot at frame centre; the camera never enters the gap.
tpl.camera: Low wide shot, 40mm, 30 cm high, eye-line of the robot. Slow Steadicam follow from behind at the robot's crawling pace (about 0.3 m/s). The move starts with the robot full-figure in the lower-centre frame and ends stopped at the slab lip, with the gap as a black slot holding a fading glow.
tpl.start: Robot full-figure in the lower centre, treads grinding forward over rubble, camera following close behind at its height.
tpl.middle: The robot dips under the slab lip and its antenna bends and scrapes along the concrete underside, throwing a small spray of grit into its own red glow.
tpl.end: The camera halts at the slab edge as the robot pushes deeper. Its glow shrinks to a dim red smear inside the black gap, framed by grey concrete above and below.
tpl.blur: Robot and slab lip crisp at T2.8. Foreground rubble at the frame edges is soft. Focus is pulled to follow the robot into the gap and holds on the glow as it recedes.
tpl.soundscape: Grinding tracks on grit, a thin metallic screech of the antenna on concrete, wind over the rubble behind, small stones trickling.

shots.design: 低机位斯坦尼康从背后跟随“螺丝”，跟到石板边缘就停住。机器自身的红白屏光一点点被黑暗吞没，镜头被留在了外面。

shots.frame: Tight shot inside the collapsed shaft, 65mm, camera low and level with the robot's treads. Foreground left: an out-of-focus jagged concrete edge in near-black. Subject: the lower body of the small yellow robot wedged between two grey slabs, treads jammed against debris, filling the centre of the 2.39 band. Its unseen screen throws a red-white glow upward that lights falling dust as glittering specks. The background is total black beyond the slabs. The air is thick with dust hanging in the glow.
shots.video: 狭小空间里的特写。“螺丝”卡在两块石板中间，把天线一节一节升起来。头顶的石板往下沉，屏幕上裂开一道缝，笑脸还亮着。环境声：混凝土的呻吟、电机吃力的声音。

tpl.summary: Wedged between two slabs, Luosi raises its antenna segment by segment while the slab above sinks and a crack splits its screen; the smiley stays lit.
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: robot wedged at frame centre between a lower slab and an upper slab; the antenna rises vertically along the centre line; the screen faces camera-right three-quarter; the smiley logo shape is reproduced exactly.
tpl.camera: Tight shot, 65mm, low level angle. One slow tilt up (about 6 seconds of travel) following the antenna. It starts on the jammed treads and debris and ends on the antenna tip touching the sinking upper slab, with the cracked glowing screen in the lower third.
tpl.start: The jammed treads twitch against the rubble, motor straining. The first antenna segment slides up out of frame.
tpl.middle: The tilt rises with each extending segment and passes the screen as a thin crack runs across it. The red-bubble white-smile face stays lit.
tpl.end: The frame lands on the antenna tip pressed to the descending slab underside. Dust pours down through the red glow, and the cracked smiley sits in the lower third.
tpl.blur: Shallow focus at T2. Focus follows the rising antenna, and the screen and crack are crisp as they pass. The foreground concrete edge stays soft. The black background has no detail.
tpl.soundscape: Deep groan of loading concrete, a high-pitched struggling servo whine, telescoping metal clicks, a fine hiss of falling dust.

shots.design: 缝隙内部的近景，65毫米。镜头从卡住的履带跟着天线一节节升起，慢慢上摇到正在下沉的石板。屏幕红白光是唯一的光源。

shots.frame: Close shot, 85mm, camera at chest height, slightly low, on the gloved hands of Amu holding a dented steel ammunition-tin node box. The box fills the lower-left foreground in sharp focus, its row of small LEDs dark except one green point. Behind and above, frame right, Amu's bowed head is soft: short messy black hair, light stubble, breath vapour. Orange Jupiter light backlights his hair and the blowing snow. His face is in cool shadow. The ice plain beyond is a dark orange-grey blur.
shots.video: 特写。阿牧手里的节点盒，灯一颗接一颗重新亮了，绿色。他猛地抬起头喊。环境声：一串急促的提示音、风声。

dialogue.line: 通了！螺丝把自己架成了中继！

tpl.summary: The lamps on Amu's node box come back on, green, one after another; he snaps his head up and shouts that the link is through and Luosi has made itself a relay.
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: node box lower left in the foreground; Amu's head upper right, behind; Jupiter backlight from behind him at frame right; snow blows left to right.
tpl.camera: Close shot, 85mm, slightly low. Locked frame with a single rack focus. Focus starts on the LEDs and racks to Amu's face as he looks up, ending on him sharp with the green dots as soft bokeh in the foreground.
tpl.start: The green LEDs blink on one by one across the box, each with a short beep, while Amu's head stays bowed and soft.
tpl.middle: As the last lamp lights, Amu's head jerks up. Focus racks to his face as the orange rim catches his scar and wet eyes.
tpl.end: Amu shouts, mouth fully visible, eyes past camera-left toward the rubble. The green LEDs glow as soft out-of-focus points at lower left.
tpl.blur: T1.8 with very shallow depth of field. LEDs crisp at the start; rack focus over about 1 second to Amu's eyes. Snowflakes pass as soft streaks.
tpl.soundscape: A rapid ascending chain of electronic beeps, gusting wind, Amu's shout cracking in the cold.

shots.design: 85毫米。焦点从节点盒上逐颗亮起的绿灯拉到阿牧抬起的脸，木星橘光作背光，风雪横穿画面。

shots.frame: Medium-wide shot, 27mm, handheld, leading in front of Amu at chest height and looking back down a dark engine gallery. Amu runs toward camera at frame centre, a rugged steel case on his right shoulder, his face strained, mouth open, breath vapour streaming. Behind him the gallery recedes as a vast black tube of ribs and pipes. A line of caged amber emergency lamps on the ceiling forms a vanishing line, the nearest overhead pool of light just catching his head. Haze hangs in each lamp's cone.
shots.video: 剧烈晃动的手持跟拍。阿牧扛着钢箱在漆黑的发动机廊道里狂奔，应急灯一盏盏从头顶掠过。环境声：沉重的脚步声、喘息、箱子的碰撞声。

tpl.summary: Amu runs flat out through the black engine gallery with the steel core case on his shoulder, emergency lamps flashing past overhead.
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: Amu stays centre-frame, running toward camera; the case on his right shoulder; the lamps form a ceiling line converging to the centre vanishing point.
tpl.camera: Medium-wide shot, 27mm, chest height. Handheld leading backward at running speed, breathing and jolting. It starts with Amu medium-wide and the gallery deep behind him, and ends with him gaining to a medium shot, filling the centre, as he passes under a lamp.
tpl.start: Amu emerges from darkness into the first amber pool, running hard, the case bouncing.
tpl.middle: Lamps pass over him in rhythm, light-dark-light, while pipes on the walls slide past soft at the frame edges.
tpl.end: He closes on the camera under a lamp, face lit amber with sweat and vapour, then plunges into the next dark gap. Cut on that motion.
tpl.blur: T2.8. Amu crisp, focus held on him at a closing distance. The deep gallery falls off soft. Lamp cones are lit by haze.
tpl.soundscape: Heavy boots on steel grating, ragged breathing, the case clanging on his shoulder, a reverberant boom down the tunnel, the buzz of the emergency lamps.

shots.design: 全片少用的剧烈手持，27毫米从正面倒退领跑。头顶应急灯一盏盏掠过，在阿牧身上打出明暗交替的节奏。

shots.frame: Medium shot, 40mm, camera inside the black gap at ground level, looking out and slightly up at Xiaoman. Foreground: out-of-focus jagged concrete edges top and bottom, framing a wide horizontal slot. In the slot, centre-right, Xiaoman kneels: a tall thin 19-year-old with messy overgrown black hair and pale skin, both palms pressed on the slab, leaning in. The orange Jupiter sky behind him rims his hair and shoulders. His face is lit only faintly red by the robot glow from inside. Breath vapour and blown snow drift around him.
shots.video: 手持镜头。小满跪在窄缝前，两只手撑着石板，朝黑洞里喊，声音都劈了。环境声：混凝土的断裂声、风声。

dialogue.line: 撑住！螺丝！再撑一会儿！

tpl.summary: Xiaoman kneels at the gap with both hands on the concrete and screams into the dark for Luosi to hold on, his voice breaking.
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: camera inside the gap; Xiaoman kneels centre-right in the slot between slab edges, facing camera; hands on the slab at the lower frame; Jupiter backlight behind him.
tpl.camera: Medium shot, 40mm, ground level, looking slightly up. Slow dolly push-in (about 20 cm over 9 seconds) through the gap. It starts as a medium shot inside the concrete slot and ends as a medium close-up with his face filling the slot.
tpl.start: Xiaoman's hands brace on the slab. He leans into the darkness, breath fogging.
tpl.middle: He screams the line, mouth wide and visible, voice splitting. Concrete cracks somewhere and grit falls past the foreground.
tpl.end: Medium close-up: his tear-wet face framed between the dark slab edges, eyes searching the black toward camera, orange rim on his hair.
tpl.blur: Xiaoman's eyes crisp at T2. Foreground slab edges fully soft and dark. The orange sky behind him is a soft glow.
tpl.soundscape: Cracking concrete, wind, his raw voice echoing into the narrow cavity, falling pebbles.

shots.design: 镜头放在窄缝的黑暗里向外看，石板边缘框住跪着的小满，木星橘光从他背后照来。缓慢推近，压紧他的哭喊。

shots.frame: Macro close-up, 100mm macro on a slider, level with the robot's cracked screen in total darkness. Foreground: soft falling dust streaks. Subject left of centre: the square screen, a crack across it, the red speech-bubble smiley with its left half dead black and the right half flickering red and white. Its light glows on scratched yellow paint at the bezel. Frame right is black, with the base of the antenna mast faintly lit. Above, the underside of the slab is barely visible. The dust is lit as a red curtain.
shots.video: 特写。屏幕上的笑脸灭了一半，剩下的一半在闪。天线还举着。灰不停地往下掉。环境声：电流的噼啪声、石板下沉的闷响。

tpl.summary: Half of the smiley on Luosi's screen has gone dark, the other half flickers; the antenna is still raised as dust keeps falling.
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: screen left of centre, crack diagonal; the antenna mast rises from the right of the screen; the slab is a dark mass at the top of frame; the dead half of the smiley is on the left.
tpl.camera: Macro close-up, 100mm, level. Slow lateral slider move left to right (about 15 cm in 8 seconds). It starts on the half-dead smiley and ends on the antenna rising vertically in the frame-right third, with the flickering screen soft at left. The cracked screen with the smiley stays inside the frame for the whole shot.
tpl.start: The half-dead face flickers, its pixels sputtering, dust falling across it.
tpl.middle: The slider drifts right past the crack and the yellow bezel to the antenna base. A dull thud shakes down more dust.
tpl.end: The antenna stands upright and still, lit by stuttering red light, the screen a soft pulsing glow at the left edge.
tpl.blur: Wafer-thin depth of field at T2.8 macro. The screen pixels are crisp, then focus slides to the antenna. Falling dust is out of focus in the foreground.
tpl.soundscape: Crackle of electrical arcing, a dull heavy thud of the slab settling, a dust hiss, a weak servo hum.

shots.design: 100毫米微距滑轨横移，掠过半灭的屏幕和仍举着的天线。灰像雨一样落在红白光里。

shots.frame: Close shot, 65mm, low angle just below a steel socket, looking up along it. Foreground: the soft dark edge of the socket collar at lower frame. Subject centre: Amu's gloved hands gripping a forearm-length metal igniter core glowing ember red at its tip, half inserted. Above, soft but readable: his strained face lit red from below, scar through his eyebrow, jaw clenched. To the right a heavy locking lever stands upright, catching a red edge. The background is black engine machinery and haze, with one distant amber lamp.
shots.video: 特写。阿牧把泛着红光的点火核心推进插座，整个人压上去，扳下锁定杆。环境声：金属咬合的巨响、他的嘶吼。

tpl.summary: Amu drives the red-glowing igniter core into the socket, throws his whole weight onto it and slams the locking lever down.
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: socket centre-low; Amu's hands on the core at centre; his face above at centre-left; the lever at frame right; all key light comes from the core's red glow.
tpl.camera: Close shot, 65mm, low angle. Slow dolly push-in (about 25 cm over 9 seconds). It starts on hands, core and face together and ends on the lever and his gloved fist slammed down, the red glow sealed in the socket.
tpl.start: Hands shove the core into the socket. Red light streaks up his face as metal grinds.
tpl.middle: He leans his full body onto it, roaring, and the core seats with a massive clank.
tpl.end: His right hand drags the lever down hard into frame. The push lands on fist and lever locked, the red glow contained, his face soft above.
tpl.blur: Hands and core crisp at T2.8, then focus rides to the lever. His face is readable but slightly soft. The haze background is soft.
tpl.soundscape: A grinding metal slide, a huge interlocking clang, Amu's hoarse yell, a deep resonant hum building inside the machine.

shots.design: 65毫米低机位近景，镜头随推送动作缓慢推进。点火核心的红光从下往上照亮阿牧压上去的脸，冷黑的钢结构作背景。

shots.frame: Locked-off close shot, 100mm, level, inside the collapsed shaft. The 2.39 frame is almost entirely black. A small glowing square sits in the right third: the robot's cracked screen with the half-dead red-and-white smiley, the logo shape exact, its faint light just defining the slab edges above and below. Foreground: out-of-focus specks of dust drifting slowly down, lit faintly red. The left two-thirds of the frame are deep, empty black.
shots.video: 特写固定镜头。笑脸最后闪了一下，灭了。屏幕是黑的。灰慢慢落下来。环境声：一切声音都停了，只剩灰落下的沙沙声。

tpl.summary: The smiley flickers one last time and goes out; the screen is black and dust slowly settles.
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: the screen is a small square in the right third; the left two-thirds are empty black, matching the film's lights-out motif composition.
tpl.camera: Close shot, 100mm, level. Locked-off and completely still for the full shot. The frame starts on a small glowing screen in a black field and ends on total black with faint settling dust.
tpl.start: The half smiley glows weakly, a small point in the darkness.
tpl.middle: It flickers once, brighter for an instant, then cuts out, and the slab edges vanish with it.
tpl.end: Pure black. A few dust motes, caught by nothing, fade from sight. Hold.
tpl.blur: Screen crisp at T2.8. Dust in the foreground is soft. Blacks crush to pure black.
tpl.soundscape: All sound drops away except a soft hiss of dust settling.

shots.design: 母题二。固定镜头，笑脸只占画面一角，作为大片黑暗里的小光点闪了最后一下，然后熄灭，只剩被余光照着的落灰。

shots.frame: Locked-off extreme wide shot, 65mm, camera low on the ice plain. Foreground: out-of-focus ice ridge across the bottom edge. Lower third: a row of tiny silhouetted human figures at a rubble mound, specks against the snow. The centre is dominated by the dark mountain-sized planetary engine, its nozzle crown silent and black. Jupiter fills the entire sky behind it, banded orange and red, the Great Red Spot upper left. The engine's base is still dark. Ice dust haze sits in the orange light.
shots.video: 固定大远景。发动机底部亮起蓝白色的光，光柱猛地冲上去，刺进木星占满的天空。环境声：从寂静中爆发的轰鸣。

tpl.summary: Blue-white light kindles at the engine's base and the plasma column blasts upward into the Jupiter-filled sky.
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: engine centred; tiny figures in the lower third, left of centre; Jupiter fills the sky; the beam rises along the frame centre and exits the top.
tpl.camera: Extreme wide shot, 65mm, low. Locked-off tableau with no move; the image itself transforms. It starts on a dark engine under the orange sky and ends with the frame split by a blinding blue-white column from bottom to top.
tpl.start: Silence. A dark engine, an orange sky, tiny figures still.
tpl.middle: A blue-white glow blooms at the engine base, flooding the ice with cold light and throwing long shadows from the tiny figures toward camera.
tpl.end: The column punches up into Jupiter's bands. The frame is bleached blue-white along the centre, with the orange sky pushed to the edges and the figures in silhouette.
tpl.blur: Deep focus at T5.6. Engine and figures sharp. The foreground ice ridge is soft. Plasma blooms naturally without clipping into shapes.
tpl.soundscape: Dead silence, then a deep roar bursting up from the ground, a rolling shockwave, ice cracking.

shots.design: 65毫米压缩透视的固定大远景。发动机像山一样立在木星天空前，脚下有一排极小的人影。蓝白光柱从底部冲上去，把整个画面漂白。

shots.frame: Close-up, 85mm, camera at kneeling height in near profile on Xiaoman's left. Foreground right: the soft black edge of the gap in the rubble. Subject centre-left: Xiaoman kneeling, head lowered toward the gap, messy overgrown hair, pale face in shadow, tear tracks. Behind him, the engine's blue-white plasma floods in as a strong backlight, rimming his hair, ear and breath vapour in cold light. Deep background: soft blown-out blue glow and tiny blurred silhouettes of cheering people against the orange sky.
shots.video: 手持特写。蓝光从背后漫过小满的脸。所有人都在欢呼，他没有回头，只盯着那道黑缝，轻轻叫了一声。环境声：远处的欢呼、发动机的轰鸣。

dialogue.line: 螺丝？

tpl.summary: Blue light floods over Xiaoman from behind while everyone cheers; he does not turn, staring into the dark gap, and quietly says the robot's name.
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: Xiaoman kneeling, facing the gap at frame right; the engine light behind him; the cheering people stay deep and soft; he never turns toward the beam.
tpl.camera: Close-up, 85mm, kneeling height. Slow arc orbit of about 40 degrees around him (10 seconds). It starts in near profile with the gap at the right and ends on a three-quarter frontal close-up, the face lit by blue spill and the black gap a soft foreground mass.
tpl.start: Profile, backlit. Distant cheers rise as the blue light grows on his hair.
tpl.middle: The camera arcs. His face slowly comes into the light, still fixed on the gap.
tpl.end: Three-quarter close-up. His lips part and he says the name softly, mouth visible, eyes into the black. Hold.
tpl.blur: Eyes crisp at T1.8. The cheering crowd is reduced to blue-orange bokeh. The foreground gap edge is soft black.
tpl.soundscape: Distant cheering, the steady engine roar, wind, his near-whisper close and dry.

shots.design: 85毫米慢速弧形环绕。蓝白光从背后漫过小满，他不回头，镜头从侧影绕到他的正脸。前景是虚化的黑缝。

shots.frame: Macro close-up, 100mm, slider level with a small battered field printer on a truck tailgate. Foreground: soft out-of-focus snow on the steel tailgate edge. Subject left: the printer's slot feeding a short curl of thermal paper. A warm tungsten work lamp behind the paper glows through it, showing rows of abstract barcode marks in silhouette. Background: soft blue-white engine light on snow and drifting ice crystals. Cold breath vapour hangs above.
shots.video: 微距特写。车尾板上的打印机吐出一小截纸带，盖上红印。一只戴手套的手把它撕下来，攥在手心。环境声：打印头的哒哒声、远处的轰鸣。
shots.vo: 最后一条回执。中继保持：三分五十秒。署名：螺丝。

tpl.summary: The field printer on the tailgate prints a short strip of receipt tape stamped with a red mark, and a gloved hand tears it off and clenches it.
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: printer at frame left, the tape curling rightward; the warm lamp behind the paper; the gloved hand enters from the top right; blue engine light in the background.
tpl.camera: Macro close-up, 100mm. Slow lateral slider move left to right along the tape (about 10 cm in 10 seconds). It starts on the print head and emerging paper and ends on the red stamp and the gloved fist closing around the strip.
tpl.start: The print head clacks. Paper inches out, glowing warm from behind.
tpl.middle: The slider follows the strip to its end as the small red square stamp prints, bright through the backlit paper.
tpl.end: A gloved hand tears the strip off and crushes it into a fist, warm light leaking through the glove fingers. The blue glow stays behind.
tpl.blur: Very shallow macro at T2.8. The paper fibre and stamp are crisp. The background blue is soft bokeh. Focus follows the tape edge.
tpl.soundscape: A clicking print head, a paper tear, the glove creaking, the distant low engine roar, wind.

shots.design: 母题三。100毫米微距滑轨。车尾作业灯的暖光透过纸带，镜头沿纸带滑到红印。远处有发动机的蓝光，最后一只手套撕下纸带。

shots.frame: Interview close shot, 85mm, eye level. Xiaoman sits in the right third of the frame, body angled toward the interviewer off frame-left, leaving deep negative space at left falling to darkness. A soft key light from frame left models his pale face. The right side of his face drops into shadow. He is a tall thin young man with messy overgrown hair and wet eyes, smiling through tears. The crushed yellow robot head is cradled in his lap at the lower frame edge, scratched paint catching the key. Background: soft out-of-focus pipes in a dim concrete room.
shots.video: 采访固定机位，近景。小满抱着压瘪的机器人脑袋，又哭又笑，说到一半停下来吸了口气，才把话说完。环境声：安静的房间底噪。

dialogue.line: 它不会说话。可它那一下，碰了碰我的手。我知道，它是怕的。

tpl.summary: In the 2078 interview, Xiaoman holds the crushed robot head in his lap, crying and smiling, pauses mid-sentence to breathe, then says Luosi could not speak but touched his hand, and he knows it was afraid.
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: Xiaoman in the right third, eyeline to frame left, matching his earlier interview setup; key from the left; the robot head in his lap at lower frame; negative space at left.
tpl.camera: Interview close shot, 85mm, eye level. An almost imperceptible slow push-in (about 8 cm over 12 seconds). It starts with head, shoulders and the robot head in frame and ends on a tighter close-up of his face, the robot head just at the lower edge.
tpl.start: He looks down at the robot head, thumb on its cracked screen, and begins speaking with a wavering smile.
tpl.middle: He stops, lips trembling, and takes a breath. Tears run as he half laughs.
tpl.end: He lifts his eyes toward the interviewer and finishes the line quietly, mouth clearly visible. Hold on his wet, steady face.
tpl.blur: Eyes crisp at T2. The robot head is slightly soft at the bottom edge. The background pipes are deeply soft, falling to black.
tpl.soundscape: Quiet room tone, a faint hum, his breath catching, a small sniff.

shots.design: 85毫米采访近景，沿用小满固定的偏右构图和左侧柔光。左侧留大片暗部，几乎察觉不到地缓慢推近。

shots.frame: Medium shot, 50mm, camera at seated eye level slightly low, frame-left foreground a soft out-of-focus edge of the radio set with a glowing amber dial. Boye sits right of centre, bent forward, one ear pressed into an old headphone cup, the other hand on a handset, eyes down and listening. Behind him, out of focus, the relit screen wall is a vast dark field scattered with thousands of tiny pale-green and warm points. The amber dial warms his beard and glasses from below. A cool white glow from the wall rims his grey hair. Faint haze hangs in the hall.
shots.video: 手持中景。波爷弯腰凑在一台滋滋响的电台前，一只耳朵贴着耳机。电台里传来一个陌生女人沉稳的声音。环境声：电台杂音。

dialogue.line: 发动机回来了。
不够。得点燃木星。

tpl.summary: Boye leans into a crackling radio and says the engine is back; a steady unfamiliar woman's voice (Zhou) answers through the static that it is not enough and that they must ignite Jupiter.
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: Boye seated right of centre, facing frame-left toward the radio, headphone on his left ear, handset in his right hand; radio dial a soft foreground block at frame-left; dot-map wall always behind him, defocused; his face stays in the middle horizontal band.
tpl.camera: Medium shot to medium close-up, 50mm, eye level slightly low; one slow dolly push-in over 9 seconds, from waist-up with the radio in the foreground to a tight head-and-shoulders where the radio dial is only a warm blur at the left edge.
tpl.start: Static crackles. Boye hunches over the set and presses the cup tighter to his ear, then says into the handset, mouth clearly visible in three-quarter profile: 'The engine is back.'
tpl.middle: The push continues. He waits. Through the hiss a calm woman's voice answers, 'Not enough.' Boye's eyes lift from the dial and stop moving.
tpl.end: 'We have to ignite Jupiter.' The camera settles on a close three-quarter of Boye, his face frozen between amber underlight and cold white rim light, the field of points behind him reduced to soft bokeh.
tpl.blur: Boye's eyes and glasses are crisp throughout, with a focus pull following the push; the foreground radio dial stays a warm blur; the dot wall dissolves into round soft points; moderately shallow depth of field.
tpl.soundscape: Radio static and carrier whine, Boye's low voice, Zhou's voice compressed through the headphone and the small speaker, faint hum of consoles waking up across the hall.

shots.design: 中近景/50mm/与坐姿齐平略低的机位/慢推近；电台刻度盘的暖琥珀光从下方照亮波爷，身后是重新亮起、由无数光点组成的屏幕墙，冷白微光勾出他的轮廓，让陌生女声在推近中压过来。

shots.frame: Medium shot, 40mm, camera at waist height. The left third of frame is filled by the soft blue backs of monitors in the console ring, out of focus. Through the gap, Researcher Zhou stands centre-right in profile, facing frame-left, in a white uniform with blue stripes. Both hands brace on the console and a radio handset is gripped in one fist, shoulders sagging, ponytail loose. Behind her, a huge observation window shows the colossal tilted steering engine against an orange sky, its blue-white glare backlighting her, haze glowing in the beam.
shots.video: 手持中景。苏拉威西控制室里，周研究员撑着操作台，握着话筒，嗓子是哑的。窗外是倾斜的转向发动机。环境声：警报的低鸣、电台杂音。

dialogue.line: 我们缺冷却液，缺人手。谁有？

tpl.summary: In the Sulawesi control room, exhausted Researcher Zhou, her voice hoarse, calls over the radio for coolant and for people, asking who has any.
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: Zhou right of centre in profile facing frame-left, braced on the console with the handset in her right hand near her mouth; the observation window and tilted engine stay behind her on frame-right; console monitors pass through the foreground.
tpl.camera: Medium shot, 40mm, waist height; one slow lateral track left-to-right along the curve of the console, monitors sliding past in the foreground, starting half-hidden behind monitor backs and ending with Zhou cleanly framed against the window.
tpl.start: Monitor backs slide across the lens. Zhou is glimpsed through the gaps, head low, breathing, the low alarm drone filling the room.
tpl.middle: The last monitor clears. She lifts the handset and speaks hoarsely, mouth visible in profile: 'We're short of coolant. Short of hands.'
tpl.end: The track stops. She raises her eyes to the window: 'Who has any?' Final frame is Zhou in crisp rim-lit profile on the right third, the slanted engine a monumental blue-white wedge filling the window beyond her.
tpl.blur: Zhou sharp, especially eye and mouth; foreground monitors are heavily defocused blue blocks; the engine through the glass is readable but soft; medium-shallow depth of field.
tpl.soundscape: Low pulsing alarm drone, radio static, the deep vibration of the engine coming through the glass, Zhou's cracked voice.

shots.design: 中景/40mm/腰部高度横移/前景显示器视差；从冷蓝仪表后滑出，停在逆光中的周研究员侧脸，窗外倾斜的转向发动机射出蓝白光，把她压成一个疲惫的轮廓。

shots.frame: Close shot, 85mm, camera low at console height looking across the desk surface. Foreground lower frame: a strip of thermal receipt paper pressed flat under Governor Xing's left fingers, its curled end glowing amber because a tungsten work lamp stands behind it and shines through the paper. Rows of abstract barcode marks show through. Her right hand enters with a pen, nib touching the paper. Above, out of focus, the soft dark shapes of operators stand behind her, faces turned toward her, faintly lit by the pale screen wall.
shots.video: 手持近景。邢总督把一条纸带按在操作台上，提笔签了字，头也没抬地说。周围的操作员都看着她。环境声：笔尖声、电台杂音。

dialogue.line: 敦煌给。全城降四度。我签。

tpl.summary: Governor Xing presses a receipt strip flat on the console, signs it, and without looking up says Dunhuang will give, the whole city drops four degrees, and she signs for it.
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: paper strip lies horizontal across the console in the lower frame with the lamp directly behind it; Xing centre-left, head bowed over it; operators stand soft behind her right shoulder; her face lands in the middle horizontal band.
tpl.camera: Close shot, 85mm, console height; one slow tilt up with a follow-focus, starting on the backlit paper and pen nib and ending on Xing's bowed face, the strip still visible at the bottom edge.
tpl.start: Near-macro on the glowing paper; the nib scratches her signature across it, light passing through the thin tape.
tpl.middle: The camera tilts up past her hand and collar as she finishes the last stroke, her eyes never leaving the paper.
tpl.end: On her bowed face, mouth visible, she says flatly: 'Dunhuang gives. The whole city drops four degrees. I sign.' Final frame: Xing tight and centred-left, the amber edge of the strip glowing below, operators frozen and soft behind her.
tpl.blur: Paper and nib crisp at the start with a very shallow plane; focus rides up with the tilt and lands crisp on Xing's eyes and mouth; operators stay blurred silhouettes; the lamp is a warm bloom behind the paper.
tpl.soundscape: Pen nib scratching on thermal paper, radio static in the background, a few held breaths, the low hum of the hall.

shots.design: 近景/85mm/操作台高度/从纸带细节缓慢上摇至面部；台灯暖光从纸带背后透过来，笔尖落在纸上，镜头升到她低垂的脸，周围操作员虚成背景。

shots.frame: Medium shot, 65mm, camera at shoulder height on the ice. A dark padded shoulder and a passing steel canister blur across the left foreground. Behind it, a line of strangers in mismatched surface suits stands in a chain left to right, passing frosted coolant canisters hand to hand, breath vapour streaming. Behind them, the flanks of heavy trucks from different convoys sit with red-white smiley stickers on their doors. Orange Jupiter light floods from the upper right, and hard white truck headlights cut through blowing ice dust.
shots.video: 手持镜头。冰原上，几支素不相识的车队碰了头，人排成一列传递冷却罐，队伍中间夹着一台装卸机器人，机械爪从人手里接过罐子，再递给下一个人。环境声：风声、金属罐的碰撞声、吆喝声。
shots.vo: 素不相识的人。素不相识的机器。

tpl.summary: On the ice, crews from convoys that have never met pass coolant canisters down a human chain, and a boxy loader robot in the middle of the line takes a canister from human hands with its claw and passes it on.
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: chain runs left to right across the middle band of frame; canisters always travel left to right; loader robot stands in the line near frame-right; trucks with smiley-sticker doors stay in the background.
tpl.camera: Medium shot, 65mm, shoulder height; one steady lateral track left-to-right alongside the chain at the speed of the canisters, bodies and canisters wiping past in the foreground, ending on the robot's claw receiving a canister.
tpl.start: The camera drifts with a canister as it is swung from one gloved pair of hands to the next, faces half-hidden by hoods and vapour.
tpl.middle: Parallax of shoulders and steel; the trucks' smiley-sticker doors slide by behind; shouted counts carry on the wind.
tpl.end: The track arrives at the boxy loader robot: a man holds out a canister and the steel claw closes on it, takes it, and turns to the next person. Final frame: the human hands and the claw meeting on the canister, centre-right, lit orange.
tpl.blur: Chain and handovers crisp; foreground bodies and canisters fully blurred; trucks soft but stickers readable; ice dust glows in the headlight beams.
tpl.soundscape: Howling wind, clank of metal canisters, hoarse shouted counts, robot servos whirring, distant idling truck engines.

shots.design: 中景/65mm/人肩高度/沿传递链横移，冷却罐和人身作前景视差；木星橘光与车灯白光交错，呼出的白气挂在空中，镜头终点停在机械爪从人手中接过罐子的瞬间。

shots.frame: Macro profile two-shot, 100mm macro, camera level with a frozen valve wheel. A gloved human hand enters from frame-left and a steel robot manipulator claw from frame-right, both gripping the same rim of an ice-crusted valve wheel, meeting near frame centre. A soft out-of-focus pipe edge crosses the extreme foreground. Behind them, hard blue-white engine light floods through haze, backlighting the glove's fibres and the claw's edges, turning frost into a bright halo. Deep black falls on the near side of both.
shots.video: 微距特写。一只戴手套的人手和一只钢制机械爪握在同一个结冰的阀轮上，一起用力，冰霜崩裂，阀轮转动。环境声：冰裂声、金属转动声。

tpl.summary: A gloved human hand and a steel robot claw grip the same frozen valve wheel and strain together until the frost cracks and the wheel turns.
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: hand from frame-left and claw from frame-right in strict profile, both on the upper rim of the wheel, meeting at centre; backlight directly behind; matches every earlier hand-and-claw shot.
tpl.camera: Macro profile two-shot, 100mm macro, level; one very slow slider push-in, from hand, claw and the wheel rim to an extreme close-up where knuckle and claw tip nearly touch on the ice.
tpl.start: Both hold still on the iced rim, glove tightening, claw joints locking, breath vapour drifting through the backlight.
tpl.middle: They strain together; fine cracks spider through the frost and the first shards spring off, glittering in the blue-white light.
tpl.end: The ice gives with a crack and the wheel turns a quarter, frost showering down. Final frame: glove and claw side by side, almost touching, rim-lit against the glare.
tpl.blur: Wafer-thin focus held on the point where glove and claw meet the rim; the foreground pipe and background are soft blue-white; ice shards sparkle as bokeh.
tpl.soundscape: Creak of strained metal, sharp crackle of breaking ice, a heavy grinding turn of the valve, deep engine rumble underneath.

shots.design: 微距/100mm微距/侧面平视/滑轨极慢推进；沿用手与机械爪的固定侧面双人构图，转向发动机的蓝白光从后方逆光，冰屑在光里崩开。

shots.frame: Extreme wide shot, 40mm, camera low on the frozen sea. Foreground: a soft black ridge of pressure ice along the bottom edge, with a tiny transport truck and two tiny standing figures silhouetted on it at frame-left. Midground and right: the colossal tilted steering engine rises from the ice like a leaning mountain, its nozzle firing a thick blue-white beam diagonally up toward the upper left. There Jupiter's orange-red bands fill the sky. The beam bleaches the ice plain white, and haze glows along its length.
shots.video: 固定大远景。冰封的海面上，倾斜的转向发动机全功率喷射，蓝色光柱直指木星，把冰面照得发白。环境声：撕裂般的轰鸣。

tpl.summary: On the frozen sea, the colossal tilted steering engine fires its blue beam at full power toward Jupiter, bleaching the ice white.
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: tiny truck and figures on the foreground ridge at frame-left; engine mass in the right two-thirds; beam on a diagonal from the right base to the upper left; Jupiter fills the upper left.
tpl.camera: Extreme wide, 40mm, low on the ice; locked-off tableau with no movement, letting the beam's force and the light shifts carry the shot.
tpl.start: The engine fires; the blue column thickens and stabilises, light racing across the ice toward the camera.
tpl.middle: The ice plain flares from grey to bleached white; snow dust lifts off the ridge in the blast.
tpl.end: Held: the beam steady and full, the tiny figures unmoving against it, Jupiter's orange face overhead. Final composition unchanged and monumental.
tpl.blur: Deep focus: figures, engine and Jupiter all readable; the foreground ridge only slightly soft; haze gives the light its volume.
tpl.soundscape: Tearing, roaring thunder of the engine; wind-blown snow hissing across the ice; deep sub-bass vibration.

shots.design: 大远景/40mm/冰面低机位/固定画面；倾斜的转向发动机如山体斜切画面，蓝色光柱刺向橘红的木星，冰面被照得发白，前景冰脊上一台极小的车辆提示比例。

shots.frame: Extreme wide upward shot, 32mm, camera on the ice plain angled steeply up. Jupiter's orange-red bands and storm swirls fill the entire frame edge to edge. Near the centre, a small point of white light has just appeared on the planet's face, brighter than anything around it. No ground is visible yet. Thin streaks of ice dust drift across the lower part of frame, catching the orange light. Deep shadow sits in the cloud bands.
shots.video: 仰拍固定大远景。木星表面绽开一团白光，无声地铺满整个天空，雪地被照成一片白。环境声：绝对的寂静，几秒后才传来低沉的闷响。

tpl.summary: A white flash blooms on the face of Jupiter and silently spreads across the whole sky, turning the snow plain white; a low boom arrives only seconds later.
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: the white bloom starts at frame centre on Jupiter; the horizon enters at the bottom during the move; a tiny row of human figures and one small robot silhouette stand on the horizon near frame centre.
tpl.camera: Extreme wide, 32mm, low on the ice; one slow tilt down over 10 seconds, from Jupiter's surface filling the frame to the horizon line sitting in the lower third with the white sky above.
tpl.start: Silence. The white point swells into a bloom, eating the orange bands outward.
tpl.middle: The tilt descends as the white spreads across the sky; the snow plain enters frame already glowing white.
tpl.end: Landing: a thin horizon in the lower third, tiny silhouetted figures and a small robot shape standing still, the whole sky white. Only then does a deep, low boom roll in.
tpl.blur: Deep focus throughout; the bloom is allowed to overexpose softly; figures on the horizon stay sharp silhouettes.
tpl.soundscape: Absolute silence for several seconds, then a delayed, deep, muffled boom and a faint shiver of wind.

shots.design: 仰拍大远景/32mm/冰原低机位/从木星表面缓慢下摇至地平线；白光在无声中铺满天空，镜头落到地平线上一排极小的人影，雪地被照成一片纯白。

shots.frame: Close group shot, 65mm, camera at face height slightly low. A blurred hooded shoulder and a drifting cloud of breath vapour fill the left foreground. Amu stands left of centre, chin raised, scarred eyebrow lit, eyes wide. Just beyond him, Xiaoman's thin pale face is tilted up, mouth slightly open. Further right, soft in depth, other crew members look up too. Hard, even white light falls from the sky onto every face, bleaching skin and frost. The background is a pale, washed-out ice plain under a white sky.
shots.video: 手持镜头，缓慢横摇。冰面上，阿牧、小满、拄着拐的金老板和其他人，脸被照得雪白，仰着头，谁也没说话。他们身边，一台小机器人也把感应头仰了起来。环境声：风声，没有人声。

tpl.summary: On the ice, Amu, Xiaoman, Boss Jin on his cane and the others stand with faces lit white, looking up in silence, and beside them a small robot tilts its sensor head up too.
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: everyone faces frame-right and upward toward the light; order left to right is Amu, Xiaoman, other crew, Boss Jin leaning on his cane, then the small robot; faces in the middle horizontal band.
tpl.camera: Close group shot, 65mm, face height slightly low; one slow lateral track left-to-right past the line of upturned faces, foreground shoulders and breath sliding by, ending on the small robot.
tpl.start: Amu's lit face, then Xiaoman's, unmoving, breath vapour rising.
tpl.middle: The track passes strangers and arrives at Boss Jin, both hands on the cane, beard frosted, staring up with wet eyes.
tpl.end: Beside Jin's leg, a small robot slowly tilts its sensor head upward, mirroring the humans. Final frame: Jin's soft profile at the left edge, the little robot crisp at right of centre, its head raised into the white light.
tpl.blur: Each face crisp as it passes centre, with a gentle focus pull from face to face; foreground shoulders and breath blurred; background a soft white wash.
tpl.soundscape: Wind across the ice, the faint creak of the cane, robot servos whirring as its head tilts, no voices.

shots.design: 近景/65mm/人脸高度/沿人群横移，前景呼气与肩膀作视差；天光把每张仰起的脸照得雪白，镜头逐一滑过阿牧、小满、金老板，最后停在仰起感应头的小机器人。

shots.frame: Extreme wide shot, 75mm, camera level on the ice plain. Foreground lower band: a dark ice plain with a few tiny warm headlights of parked trucks scattered as small points in the dusk. Horizon in the lower third: several thin blue-white engine beams rise straight up at intervals, steady and calm. Behind them, filling the upper middle, the disc of Jupiter burns with a ragged white-orange ring of fire, slightly smaller than in earlier shots. The sky around it is deep black, with faint haze along the horizon.
shots.video: 固定大远景。地平线上，几道发动机的光柱稳稳地亮着，燃烧的木星在它们背后，一点一点变小。环境声：平稳的轰鸣、风声。

tpl.summary: On the horizon, several engine beams burn steadily while the burning disc of Jupiter behind them slowly grows smaller.
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: horizon in the lower third; beams spaced evenly across it; Jupiter centred above, framed between two beams; tiny truck lights scattered in the foreground darkness.
tpl.camera: Extreme wide, 75mm, level; locked-off tableau, no camera movement, so Jupiter's slow shrinking against fixed beams is the only change.
tpl.start: The beams stand still; Jupiter's burning disc fills much of the upper frame.
tpl.middle: Almost imperceptibly, the disc shrinks; the ring of fire dims a fraction.
tpl.end: Jupiter is visibly smaller, more black sky around it; the beams hold steady, tiny truck lights glow below. Final frame a calm, layered composition of small lights in a vast dark.
tpl.blur: Deep focus from the foreground truck lights to Jupiter; light haze softens the beams' bases only.
tpl.soundscape: Steady distant roar of engines, low wind across the ice, an occasional faint creak of settling ice.

shots.design: 大远景/75mm长焦/冰原平视/固定画面；地平线上几道细长光柱稳定燃烧，燃烧的木星在其后缓缓缩小，前景车队的小车灯成为黑暗中的暖点。

shots.frame: Medium shot, 40mm, camera mounted high on the wall axis just below the red lens, angled gently down. Amu stands dead centre, small within the frame, face tilted up toward camera, hands loose at his sides. Behind him the tiered command hall recedes in strict one-point perspective: empty consoles, rows of dark chairs, a vanishing point behind his head. Frame-left, out of focus in the foreground, a sliver of brushed-steel wall panel. A faint red wash falls on his brow from above; screen-right, the wall map of thousands of tiny warm dots glows softly. Thin haze hangs in the hall; blacks fall away into the upper tiers. Amu is bare-headed (short messy black hair, no hat, no helmet); the only red in the frame is a faint red glow from the lens above falling on the floor in front of him.
shots.video: 固定中景。安静下来的指挥大厅里，阿牧独自站着，抬头看着红色镜头。平静的合成男声开口，他答了一句。环境声：屏幕的低鸣。

dialogue.line: 你们选择了低效的方式。
我们选择了彼此。

tpl.summary: Alone in the quiet command hall, Amu looks up at the red MOSS lens; MOSS says 'You chose the inefficient way,' and Amu answers, 'We chose each other.'
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: Amu exactly on the vertical centre line, his head in the middle band of the frame, his face lifted toward camera; the hall's vanishing point sits behind his head; the steel panel stays frame-left, the dot map glows frame-right; he does not move his feet.
tpl.camera: Medium shot, 40mm, high angle from the MOSS lens position looking down. Locked-off symmetric tableau, no movement; the start and end framing are identical.
tpl.start: Silence and the low hum of the screens. Amu stands still, eyes fixed on the lens; the red light holds steady on his forehead.
tpl.middle: The calm synthetic voice speaks from just above camera: 'You chose the inefficient way.' Amu does not blink; his jaw settles.
tpl.end: Amu answers quietly with his mouth clearly visible: 'We chose each other.' He holds the look. The frame stays perfectly symmetric, a small warm face in a cold, ordered hall. One continuous take in the command hall with no cut to any other place or angle.
tpl.blur: Deep-ish stop: Amu's face is crisp; the receding console rows soften gradually toward the vanishing point; the steel panel edge in the foreground is fully out of focus.
tpl.soundscape: Low electrical hum of the screen wall, faint ventilation, the voice slightly reverberant in the empty hall, Amu's breath.

shots.design: 以MOSS的视角做对称中景：机位在红色镜头正下方俯视阿牧，单点透视的冷色大厅向后纵深，固定不动；顶光红晕与侧墙点阵屏上的暖色小光点在他脸上交汇，象征秩序与人情的最后对话。

shots.frame: Extreme close-up, 100mm macro, camera dead level with the MOSS lens, perfectly centred and symmetric. The round black glass fills the middle of the wide frame, ringed by a thin brushed-steel bezel that fades out of focus at the left and right edges. At the centre glows the steady red iris. Curved across the lower half of the glass lies a small reflection of Amu, seen from the front, standing in the warm speckle of the dot map. Above and around him, the reflected hall is near-black. A faint red halo blooms into the surrounding darkness.
shots.video: 大特写固定镜头。红色镜头的玻璃上，阿牧的倒影转身，越走越小。镜头没有回答。环境声：轻微的电流声。

tpl.summary: In the red lens's black glass, Amu's reflection turns and walks away, growing smaller, while the lens itself does not change.
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: the red iris stays fixed at frame centre; Amu's reflection sits just below and left of centre, curved by the glass; the bezel frames both sides symmetrically; the red light never changes intensity.
tpl.camera: Extreme close-up, 100mm macro, eye-level and frontal. Locked-off, no movement; the start and end framing are identical.
tpl.start: The reflection of Amu faces the lens for a beat, small and warm against the black glass.
tpl.middle: He turns his back and begins walking; his reflected figure shrinks and drifts toward the curved centre of the glass.
tpl.end: He becomes a tiny warm speck and dissolves into the reflected darkness. Only the unchanging red iris remains in the dead-centre composition.
tpl.blur: Focus is set on the glass surface and iris, which stay crisp; the reflection is readable but slightly soft; the bezel falls off to blur at the frame edges.
tpl.soundscape: A faint electrical whine from the terminal, distant footsteps fading in the hall, then only the hum.

shots.design: 100mm微距固定大特写，红色镜头居中绝对对称；玻璃上阿牧的暖色小倒影转身远去，越缩越小，镜头本身纹丝不变——机器无言，冷对称包住渐行渐远的人。

shots.frame: Medium close-up, 85mm, camera at seated eye level, slightly off-axis. Amu sits in frame-right third, shoulders angled toward frame-left, eyes on the unseen interviewer just left of lens. A single soft key from camera-left models his face in warm neutral light: the scar through his left eyebrow reads, and the far cheek falls into shadow. Deep negative space fills the left half of the frame, a dim concrete wall with out-of-focus pipes dissolving into black. A faint edge of the metal chair back catches light. Calm, unhurried posture, hands resting together low in the frame.
shots.video: 采访固定机位。阿牧看着采访者，平静地说，说完没有再补充。环境声：安静的房间底噪。

dialogue.line: 规则不属于任何一个人，所以，才属于所有人。

tpl.summary: In the 2078 interview, Amu looks at the interviewer and says calmly, 'Rules belong to no single person, and that is why they belong to everyone,' then adds nothing more.
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: Amu stays in the right third with the same chair, key side and background as his earlier interview; his eyeline goes just left of lens; his face stays in the middle band of the frame, well clear of the top edge.
tpl.camera: Medium close-up, 85mm, eye level. An almost imperceptible slow push-in, from a chest-up medium close-up to a slightly tighter shoulders-up framing over 10 seconds.
tpl.start: Amu sits still, gathering the thought; the room is silent.
tpl.middle: He speaks the line evenly, his mouth clearly visible, with a small pause at 'so'.
tpl.end: He finishes and simply holds the interviewer's gaze, adding nothing. The frame settles tighter on his face, with the dark left side still open.
tpl.blur: Shallow focus: Amu's eyes and mouth are crisp; the chair edge is slightly soft; the pipes and wall behind fall into creamy darkness.
tpl.soundscape: Quiet room tone, a faint ventilation hiss, his voice close and dry.

shots.design: 延续阿牧采访的既定机位：85mm近景，人物偏右，左侧留大片暗部负空间，左侧柔光主光，背景管道沉入黑暗，几乎察觉不到的缓推收紧他的平静。

shots.frame: Close-up, 50mm, chest height, camera hugging the corridor wall and looking down its length. In the foreground, one thermal receipt strip hangs out of focus, glowing amber because a tungsten wall lamp behind it shines through the paper; its barcode rows are faintly visible. Beyond it, thousands of pinned strips recede along the concrete wall in soft overlapping layers, stirring in the vent draught. Deep in the cyan-grey corridor stand small, dark figures of people before the wall. Warm lamp pools alternate with shadow, and light haze drifts through the beams.
shots.video: 手持镜头，缓慢前移。一条长走廊的墙上，钉满了成千上万条回执纸带，被通风口的风吹得轻轻翻动。人们站在墙前，一个孩子伸手摸了摸其中一条，旁边停着一台小维修机器人。环境声：纸带的沙沙声、低声的交谈。
shots.vo: 每一份付出都被记住了。人的，和机器的。

tpl.summary: Moving slowly down a corridor wall covered in thousands of receipt strips stirring in the vent air, we arrive at a child touching one strip beside a small maintenance robot.
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: the strip wall runs along frame-left the whole time; people stand quietly in the corridor at mid-depth; the child and the small robot wait frame-right of centre at the destination; nobody crosses the lens.
tpl.camera: Close foreground into medium, 50mm, chest height. Slow forward tracking along the wall at walking-pace-and-a-half slower than a stroll, with the strips passing as foreground parallax. It starts on the backlit strip in the foreground and ends on a medium two-shot of the child and the robot.
tpl.start: The glowing foreground strip flutters and slides out of frame-left as the camera begins to move; layers of strips pass by in soft focus.
tpl.middle: Silent adults pass in profile, some reading strips, their warm-lit faces drifting by as the corridor opens ahead.
tpl.end: The camera eases to a stop. The child reaches up and touches a single strip with a fingertip; the little robot stands still beside the child. The paper glows warm against the cool corridor.
tpl.blur: Shallow focus at the start, with only the foreground strip's grain readable. Focus follows smoothly ahead and lands crisp on the child's hand and the strip; the background wall stays soft.
tpl.soundscape: Rustling of thousands of paper strips, a soft ventilation draught, low murmured conversation, distant footsteps.

shots.design: 以纸带母题开场：前景一条纸带被暖钨灯透亮，浅景深；摄影机沿纸带墙缓缓前移，层层纸带形成前景视差，最后落在孩子伸手触碰纸带、小机器人停在一旁的画面。

shots.frame: Medium shot, 65mm, camera at seated eye level, side-on. In the foreground, out-of-focus shelf clutter of coiled wire and an old monitor edge blocks frame-left. Through the gap, Xiaoman bends over the workbench, his face lowered, holding a soldering iron inside the opened, dented yellow body of the robot; its cracked screen is black. Frame-right, Boye's arm and shoulder hold a tungsten work lamp low over the bench, casting a warm pool. A thin thread of solder smoke curls through the beam; the stall behind falls into near-black shelves.
shots.video: 手持中景。修理铺的台灯下，小满埋头在“螺丝”被压瘪的机身里焊线，屏幕是裂的、黑的。波爷在旁边替他举着灯。环境声：电烙铁的滋滋声。

tpl.summary: Under the warm lamp in the repair stall, Xiaoman solders wires inside Luosi's crushed body while Boye holds the lamp for him.
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: the workbench runs horizontally across the lower-middle band; Xiaoman is seated left of centre behind the robot; the robot's dark cracked screen faces camera-right; Boye stands frame-right holding the lamp, his face partly above the beam; the lamp stays steady.
tpl.camera: Medium shot, 65mm, eye level of the seated Xiaoman. Slow lateral track right-to-left with foreground shelf parallax. It starts half-masked by the clutter and ends on a clean three-quarter view of Xiaoman's face with the robot body and Boye's lamp hand in frame.
tpl.start: Foreground wire coils slide across; behind them the iron tip touches a joint and a puff of smoke rises in the beam.
tpl.middle: The clutter clears. Xiaoman's focused face appears, lit from below by the warm lamp; Boye shifts the lamp a little closer.
tpl.end: The camera settles on Xiaoman in three-quarter view, eyes red-rimmed and steady, the dark cracked screen in the lower foreground and Boye's lamp hand at frame-right.
tpl.blur: Shallow focus: Xiaoman's hands and face are crisp; the foreground clutter is heavily blurred; Boye is slightly soft; the background shelves melt into darkness.
tpl.soundscape: Sizzle of the soldering iron, the tick of the cooling iron, Boye's slow breathing, faint alley hum outside.

shots.design: 修理铺中景，65mm侧向横移，前景杂物货架形成视差；波爷手举的工作灯是唯一暖光源，焊烟在光束里升起，横移落在小满专注的脸上，暖色回归。

shots.frame: Close-up, 65mm, camera level with the robot's screen, slightly off-axis from the left. The square black screen sits left of centre in its scratched yellow housing, a jagged crack running horizontally across its lower half. In the foreground lower right, the out-of-focus tip of a soldering iron rests on the bench, a wisp of smoke catching faint light. The background is near-black stall shelving with one soft warm lamp bokeh at the far right. Dust motes hang still in the darkness before the dead screen. IMPORTANT: in this opening frame the screen is switched OFF - completely black dead glass with only the crack catching a thin line of warm light; no smiley visible yet.
shots.video: 特写固定镜头。裂了一道缝的屏幕闪了两下，笑脸重新亮了起来，裂缝正好横在笑容上。环境声：一声熟悉的开机提示音。

tpl.summary: The cracked screen flickers twice and the red-and-white smiley lights up again, the crack running right across the smile.
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: the screen stays left of centre, the same framing as the robot's first power-on; the crack is horizontal across the lower half where the smile appears; the iron tip stays in the foreground lower right.
tpl.camera: Close-up, 65mm, screen-level, slightly off-axis. Locked-off, no movement; the start and end framing are identical.
tpl.start: The dark screen sits still in the black; there is a beat of silence.
tpl.middle: The screen flickers once, then again, throwing brief red flashes across the dust.
tpl.end: The red speech-bubble smiley with its connected node squares and white smile glows steadily; the crack cuts across the smile. Red-white light spills onto the yellow housing and the drifting dust.
tpl.blur: The screen and crack are crisp; the foreground iron tip is blurred; the background is a soft dark with a single warm bokeh.
tpl.soundscape: Faint electrical crackle, then the familiar short power-on chime, the faint whir of an internal fan.

shots.design: 与第一次开机的特写同构呼应：65mm固定特写，裂屏居中偏左，前景是虚化的烙铁尖；屏幕两闪后红白笑脸亮起，成为画面里唯一的光源，照亮浮尘。

shots.frame: Medium shot, 65mm, camera at floor level, strict profile. Xiaoman crouches at frame-left facing right, face in the middle band, wet-eyed and laughing, his open palm extended toward centre. The dented yellow robot sits at frame-right facing left, its cracked smiley screen glowing red-white. Behind and between them, the warm tungsten work lamp on the bench creates a strong backlight, rimming his fingers and the robot's steel claw. In the foreground, a blurred edge of a toolbox frames the bottom. Shelves behind fall into dark, with haze glowing around the lamp.
shots.video: 手持低机位中景。小满又哭又笑，蹲下来伸出手掌。“螺丝”抬起机械爪，碰了碰他的手心，和第一次一样。环境声：电机声、他的笑声。

dialogue.line: 欢迎回家，螺丝。

tpl.summary: Laughing through tears, Xiaoman crouches and holds out his palm, says 'Welcome home, Luosi,' and the robot raises its claw to touch his hand, just like the first time.
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: Xiaoman is frame-left in profile facing right, the robot frame-right in profile facing left, and the hand and claw meet at frame centre against the backlight; this is the same staging and backlight direction as every hand-and-claw shot in the film.
tpl.camera: Medium to tight profile two-shot, 65mm, floor level. Slow dolly push-in, starting on the full profile medium of Xiaoman and the robot and ending on the tight backlit profile two-shot of hand and claw.
tpl.start: Xiaoman crouches, laughing and crying, his mouth clearly visible, and says, 'Welcome home, Luosi,' as he opens his palm.
tpl.middle: The camera eases in. The robot's motors whir and its claw lifts slowly toward his hand.
tpl.end: The claw's steel tip touches the centre of his palm. The frame lands on the motif: hand and claw in profile, rim-lit by the warm lamp behind, with soft dark around them.
tpl.blur: Shallow focus: Xiaoman's face is crisp during the line, then focus settles on the hand and claw as they meet; the background lamp becomes a large warm bokeh.
tpl.soundscape: Small servo whir, track creak, Xiaoman's shaky laugh and sniff, a faint lamp buzz.

shots.design: 地面高度侧面构图，背光逆光：先是小满蹲下说话的完整侧面中景，再缓推到手与机械爪的经典逆光侧面双人特写，与全片手爪母题严格同构，暖灯在两者之间亮出轮廓。

shots.frame: Medium close-up, 85mm, camera at seated eye level. Boye sits in the left third of the frame, body angled toward frame-right, eyes on the unseen interviewer just right of lens. A single soft key from camera-right lights his grey-white beard and the taped black-framed glasses, the far side of his face sinking into shadow. The right half of the frame is deep negative space: dim concrete with out-of-focus pipes dissolving into black. One hand is raised to the glasses' frame. Fine grain, warm-neutral skin.
shots.video: 采访固定机位。波爷扶了扶眼镜，看着采访者，一句一句慢慢地说，说完笑了一下。环境声：安静的房间底噪。

dialogue.line: 勇气不是不怕。是怕，还把手伸出去。人类的赞歌，就是勇气的赞歌。连一台小机器，都懂。

tpl.summary: In the 2078 interview, Boye adjusts his glasses and slowly says, 'Courage isn't not being afraid. It's being afraid and still reaching out your hand. The hymn of humanity is a hymn of courage. Even a little machine understands that,' then smiles.
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: Boye stays in the left third with the same chair, key side and background as his earlier interviews; his eyeline goes just right of lens; his face stays in the middle band of the frame.
tpl.camera: Medium close-up, 85mm, eye level. An almost imperceptible slow push-in over 13 seconds, from a chest-up framing to a shoulders-up framing.
tpl.start: Boye nudges his taped glasses into place, lowers his hand and looks at the interviewer.
tpl.middle: He speaks sentence by sentence with small pauses, his mouth clearly visible and the light glinting on his lenses.
tpl.end: He says the last line about the little machine, then a small, stubborn smile breaks. The frame rests slightly tighter, with the dark space still open to his right.
tpl.blur: Shallow focus: his eyes behind the glasses and his mouth are crisp; the shoulder edge is soft; the pipes behind are fully blurred into dark.
tpl.soundscape: Quiet room tone, faint ventilation, the soft creak of the chair, his voice close.

shots.design: 延续波爷采访的既定机位：85mm近景，人物偏左，右侧留深色负空间，右侧柔光主光勾出镜片与胡须，几乎察觉不到的缓推，落在他最后那一下笑。

shots.frame: Wide shot, 40mm, camera at sill height inside a dark cabin, looking out through a frosted window. Frame-left of centre on the sill, the small dented steel node box with its smiley sticker sits in a faint warm spill from an unseen interior lamp; its single green lamp glows. Beyond the glass, the blue-white ice plain stretches to a low horizon across the middle band. Far right, several thin engine beams rise steadily, with a pair of tiny truck lights at their foot. Upper right within the band, Jupiter is a single bright point. Breath-frost edges the glass.
shots.video: 固定镜头，极缓慢推近。窗台上，一只贴着笑脸的小铁盒一下一下闪着绿灯。窗外是冰原、发动机的光柱，和已经缩成一个亮点的木星。环境声：平稳的轰鸣，小灯的提示音。
shots.vo: 路还有两千五百年。灯还亮着。

tpl.summary: On a cabin windowsill, a small node box with a smiley sticker blinks its green lamp, while beyond the glass lie the ice plain, the steady engine beams, and Jupiter shrunk to a bright point.
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: the node box stays left of centre on the sill in the lower-middle band; the horizon runs across the middle; the engine beams stay frame-right with tiny truck lights at their base; Jupiter is a bright point upper-right, kept inside the 2.39 band; the window frame edges stay dark at the sides.
tpl.camera: Wide to medium-wide, 40mm, sill height. Extremely slow dolly push-in over 10 seconds, from a wide view of the dark room, window and landscape to a framing where the box and window fill the frame and the engine beams and Jupiter remain visible.
tpl.start: Dark room, one green blink on the sill, and the cold vast plain beyond.
tpl.middle: The lamp blinks again with a soft tone; the camera creeps closer and frost crystals on the glass catch the green.
tpl.end: The frame settles on the small box blinking against the immense pale landscape, with the steady beams and the tiny point of Jupiter. One small green light in a great calm dark.
tpl.blur: Moderately deep focus: the node box and sticker are crisp; the window frost is slightly soft; the distant beams and Jupiter are readable but gently soft.
tpl.soundscape: Steady low engine rumble through the walls, a faint wind against the glass, the soft periodic tone of the node lamp.

shots.design: 全片终镜：暗室窗内，前景一点绿灯在大片暗部中呼吸（灯光母题的最终回响），窗外冰原、远方发动机光柱与缩成一点的木星层层后退，40mm极缓推近，暖内冷外，第一次的安宁。
